http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=13e7024509-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_09_06_59&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-13e7024509-584862049

Hello Coloradans,

Today, as I sit down to write my letter, I am reminded of those things that make our character our own. The good as well as the bad, and if we use those things to either improve ourselves or if we allow those things to destroy us.

This week I would like to talk a little bit about the Truth (https://www.lopez2022.com/truth?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=13e7024509-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_09_06_59&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-13e7024509-584862049) page we have just uploaded to our website. In a nutshell, life happens, we are all mere humans. There are times in all our lives when life happens in a way that we are not prepared for and sometimes not mature enough to handle, whether it is about money, work, family, we all encounter these trials. Greg and I view these as life lessons which give us opportunities to grow, learn, and become better versions of ourselves.

With that, I encourage you to go to Lopez2022.com/truth (https://www.lopez2022.com/truth?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=13e7024509-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_09_06_59&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-13e7024509-584862049) and view these instances. Greg, as a public servant, and both of us, as parents and as a couple, have never hidden from our mistakes because we know they are a very real part of life, and that is why we are willing to be open and transparent about these occurrences in our past.

In fact, it is moments like these that have encouraged us to teach our son and daughter, when they were young, that they will surely make mistakes. But to take those mistakes and learn from them. And most importantly, don't repeat them!

Sincerely,
Lisa Lopez

“Let the one among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone...” - God

body:
Thank you...We Have Work to Do!

Thank you for helping me to become the Democratic nominee in West Virginia's 1st District for U.S. House! This brings us one step closer to securing the basic rights and privileges that are due so many of us that remain terribly underrepresented and left behind.

Now let’s be clear from the outset...this campaign to secure the rights of working families will be an uphill battle. Therefore, it is critical for our future victory to understand who and what we are really fighting against. During this election year, I will be fighting against corporate interests and dark money - full stop. Running a successful campaign in 2022 will be unlike any previous endeavor. I promise you that we can and will reshape, redefine, and reinvigorate West Virginia. Allow me the opportunity to represent each and every one of you. Together, we will reassert West Virginia's presence and stature in our nation!

My campaign is unlike any other and it is historic in this regard: I am the first African American Congressional Democratic nominee for southern West Virginia, I need your assistance and support to pull this victory off...which is why I have to ask you to help (in your own individual way) by contributing to my goal of raising $250,000.00 for the success of this daunting, but doable task. Knowing the millions and potentially billions of dollars the opposition will use against us this campaign season, your small personal investment in our collective futures is minor compared to what is at stake if we allow the status quo to continue. We have to draw the line. We cannot let dark money continue to dictate the outcomes of our elections and influence our lives...

Let's make history together.

# [Theresa Ellis announces run for re-election for Manassas City Council](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/06/10/theresa-ellis-announces-run-for-re-election-for-manassas-city-council/)

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:
Contact: Theresa Coates Ellis
TheresaCoatesEllis.com
Cell: 571-247-6729
info@TheresaCoatesEllis.com
June 9, 2022
Subject line: Theresa Coates Ellis runs for re-election for Manassas City Council.
[Manassas, Virginia, June 9, 2022] -- Manassas City Councilwoman Theresa Coates Ellis announced that she is running and seeks to earn residents' vote for re-election after serving her first year term. Theresa Coates Ellis, a Republican, will be on the general election ballot on November 8th, 2022 at your regular precinct location.
As a resident, long-time successful small business owner, healthcare manager with a background in finance, communication and marketing for more than 30 years in the City or Manassas, Ellis finds solutions to overcome the challenges and hardships that face our families, businesses, education, organizations, and community.
Theresa Coates Ellis made the following statement:
"I will continue to fight against higher taxes and wasteful spending and will support safety for our City of Manassas community, residents, businesses, families, and students. I have been a champion to our small businesses and future workforce, and I will continue to help them to recover, grow, and thrive for the future. Businesses are facing workforce shortages and students and their families are deeply impacted by severe learning loss. We must act with common sense to provide resources that are needed for education to maintain safety while providing our children with the high quality education that they deserve. Our children will not be left behind; they are our greatest natural resource.”
Ellis had been a lone voice on City Council for part of her term standing with residents against increased tax bills, unnecessary spending and policies that are a burden on residents who are struggling. During the crippling COVID-19 shut down, she stepped up and was a leader with common sense solutions helping small businesses stay open with her work with Economic Development and the Airport Commission. She began a campaign to increase our blood supply when it was depleted to help surpass local goals. While working with her Rotary members as a past Area Governor of the international service organization, she actively fought to stop Human Trafficking, now a national public health crisis, after lockdowns left young adults vulnerable to predators. She also initiated proclamations in Council to bring awareness to these serious issues during her term.
She raised 6 daughters and 1 son with her husband George Ellis in the City of Manassas, attending public schools and universities. Her son is active in the U.S. Air Force and her one daughter is a veteran.
As a Business Communication graduate of George Mason University, she was awarded " Alumna of the Year," in 2019 from the Communication Department.
Even as an elected City Councilwoman, she continues her volunteerism, leadership, and voice for the Prince William Master Gardeners, with Prince William Regional Beekeepers Association as a beekeeper, Rotary International, American Red Cross, Prince William Chamber of Commerce, Suicide Awareness, and finding a cure for Alzheimer’s Disease. She was a past leader in the Girl Scouts to her daughter's troop years ago and is a member of All Saints Catholic Church, Manassas.
Ellis achieved the designation for Manassas City as a “Bee City USA” in her efforts to promote sustainability with the Beautification Committee, and founded her own “Shadow for a Day” program to help spotlight careers and connect students to professionals and jobs for opportunities to move forward.
As an entrepreneur and small business owner, she served as Council for the City’s economic development authority, Land Use, the Manassas Regional Airport Commission, Solid Waste, Keep Manassas Beautiful, and the Legislative Committee.
Ellis said, “I look forward to continuing to serve the people in the City of Manassas as we move forward together to thrive. The City of Manassas has many exciting events planned. I look forward to our 2nd annual Manassas Bee Festival on June 25th 10-2 at Liberia House and Grounds that I initiated as we celebrate the 400th anniversary of the honeybee arriving in America -- first in Virginia. We will celebrate the 150th anniversary of the founding of Manassas in 2023. Please consider me for your vote for re-election on November 8th for Manassas City Council.”
Ellis upcoming priorities include continuing the fight against increased taxes and excess spending during the highest inflation rate in 40 years. Continuing strong economic development and redevelopment to attract quality businesses, jobs and a workforce for increased revenue. Support public safety to keep our neighborhoods and schools safe and enforce codes and ordinances. Support educational and emotional recovery for a generation of children with severe learning loss and mental health issues due to the extended closing of schools and provide them with the best education that is possible. Support election integrity that is fair and transparent. Continue quality constituent service with regular communication and availability as #YourCouncilwoman to #TalkWithTheresa
Visit TheresaCoatesEllis.com to learn more about upcoming events, City news and to support Theresa for Council.

| Friends,
Check out this great article in the New Boston Post on my race for Lt. Governor:

"While the pandemic and current political problems the state faces inspired Allen to get back into electoral politics, she says that her experience in the legislature, as well as Diehl's experience, would be an asset in the State House.
"We're familiar with the lawmaking process and how business runs up here," Allen said. "We're also familiar with the power structure that goes on up there. That's why the people of Massachusetts deserve a team in the corner office that will fight for them and not just go along with the status quo; we won't just go along with some of the aggressive policies that will harm the people of Massachusetts."

name: Leah Cole Allen
subject: Reminder: A Mom and a Registered Nurse
body:
Protecting Children is my FIRST Priority
| | | |
---
---
---
| Massachusetts legislators have decided to advance a bill that would eliminate religious exemptions for parents who choose not to vaccinate their school-aged children because of their beliefs.
Despite an uncharacteristically large showing of constituent opposition to these bills at every hearing held by the Joint Committee on Public Health (including over 300 people showing up to oppose them during a blizzard in 2019!), they still opted to give this dangerous legislation a favorable vote. Who do these legislators represent?
Freedom of religion is protected by the Massachusetts Constitution, along with the right of the people to enjoy and protect their lives and liberties. Removing the religious exemption in Massachusetts--and barring children from attending public and private school as a result--is discrimination and a huge overreach of government authority.
Many will point to Jacobson v. Massachusetts as precedent for these decisions, however, this century-old court decision is no longer relevant. (Check out this great article for some background: [It's Not Your Grandfather's Public Health Law ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GuhBBoS7gnv_QS3kn3HubLo2P9d6xnoiIcbxsNUqfPcjIPRyAy32YmYnPYh3pZkLmQ959j6kRJghvnzQgCZ1-AvcV_IcM5hjnmpbXd7Tvq50Y2eDi1lHIK1DlTmHdoTan2Dwb-zI44CyWI5n5WjZTwB313BVZYXhGHpqwmgsXjKR08M6vhY0ue03BfCyRgKDDY7s5EHg1wXUEvUhGzTMDiI6m77E5o0bx9x-wgSHo1BiGGnE5JPaD6dJgq6jIeCgmHvVbpbRvI3qec23gohPoxzY6VPpGoW1&c=Rh8tyMr5w-lXnXPg2Yq5OgIkqKBn9AaU9yY9i4rfg48xPZc_0sBEVg==&ch=BpjNWZNqL6PKyFgCeCVftGDN0JqTnvy6-eWzjRHBxJETkL9gZPVS9A==)side note- Jacobson was only required to pay a $5 fine and then went on with his life.
Parents know what is best for their children, and unlike government bureaucrats, have their best interests at heart. Medical decisions should be made by parents. Period. And those personal decisions should not prevent a child from having access to education.
As lieutenant governor, I will fight to protect these rights at every turn. "The Bill of Rights was designed to protect individuals against abuses by the state, even when the abuses have the support of the majority. This is why constitutional protection of liberty remains so important." Mariner et al (2005)
All my Best,
Leah Cole Allen Mother and Registered Nurse Candidate for Lt. Governor

Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: A new enemy has emerged
body:
Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6038%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=B4lpdKV9vRp5txYGQA5K1A&sysid=1)
[** **](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62388%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AVxKziQSXoR5ucPq37b3aQ&sysid=1)
Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**>> DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62389%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LXCH9S4sJxTTiT%2b2KAZCkw&sysid=1)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself - the time is NOW.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62380%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2feaSXpNJ8FiLqEik3qr19g&sysid=1)
[**If you’re with me,**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62381%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ru5FWyDdESFgM%2boYFYhuQw&sysid=1)[**Friend****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62382%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nv3q0Gtrq0EtxgABsPAeUg&sysid=1) I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis
[CHIP IN NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62383%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DBMcOhfjei5tmHIXBMulQg&sysid=1)

name: American Update
subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9113%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=Si%2fvE68mYSZSLZ3Qb98zCw&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24729%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Bg7YCpICLq4j9crm5xf5zg&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24720%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bUgggxaxwoH8NEfPhdOUfw&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24720%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bUgggxaxwoH8NEfPhdOUfw&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Edith Luftig (Nikki's Grandma)
subject: I’m 92 and know one thing for sure
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Dear Peter,
My name is Edith Luftig, and Nikki Fried is my granddaughter.
I’m 92 years old, and this week, I published an op-ed in the Sun-Sentinel, talking about my experience trying to get medical care as a senior in Florida.
To put it simply, it was the ultimate indignity.
I was mistreated, ignored, and charged $28,000 for being handled like cattle. And I know I’m not the only one with a story like this.
We must do better by our seniors, and my granddaughter has a plan to make that happen.
Her plan will lower our costs and raise our standards. It’ll give seniors a billion-dollar tax rebate, improve transportation options, lower prescription drug costs, and help facilities like mine with critical staffing levels. As our next governor, Nikki will make sure seniors are treated with care, dignity, and respect.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=610grandma [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=610grandma]
When Nikki told me she was considering running for Governor, I told her it would be a hard thing. But I couldn’t be more proud to see her stand up and advocate for those of us who need it most, no matter how challenging it gets.
My husband, Norman Luftig, was a veteran who served this nation in World War II, fighting to protect our rights. More than 75 years later, Nikki is running for governor to defend those same rights — for our freedom of speech, for our freedom to do what we want with our own bodies, and for the rights of seniors like me to be treated with care and dignity.
I’m proud to support my granddaughter, and I hope you’ll join me by making a donation to her campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-jun-2022?refcode=610grandma]
With thanks,
Edith Luftig

Schools across Wisconsin are wrapping up the academic year, and students and teachers alike are headed into summer break. But for too many teachers, the summer doesn’t come with vacation - instead, they’re working second jobs to make ends meet. In a 2021 national survey, more than half of all teachers polled said that they currently held multiple jobs.

As the daughter of an educator, Deb knows firsthand the lengths our teachers go to to make sure our children can thrive.

Deb’s mother was a teacher educator at the University of Wisconsin-Stout. Deb watched her mom plan lessons, get to campus hours early, and stay late to help her students. She saw just how hard teachers work and understands how important it is that our leaders prioritize our educators and school staff.

Peter, do you agree with Deb that public school teachers deserve a raise?

We’re conducting a poll to hear directly from you: Do you believe public school teachers deserve a raise? | ** | ---|--- As the daughter of an educator, Deb knows firsthand the lengths our teachers go to to make sure our children can thrive. She saw just how hard teachers work and understands how important it is that our leaders prioritize our educators and school staff. Over a career of nearly 50 years of media and journalism, I was fortunate to tell the stories of Utah. To travel from small towns to big cities, the halls of government and neighborhoods.

To me, people learn the stories of the past, the issues of the present, and how they will inform and grace the future of this great state.

That experience leads me to a simple conclusion.

"This year, for United States Senate, I'm supporting Ally Isom."

"Ally embodies the Utah Spirit. She carries the values of the Utah experience with her as she journeys through these towns and neighborhoods - getting to know you and the issues that will shape our future."

Her service to the state on the local level, at the state level, business and in her faith - demonstrates her commitment to representing our voice in Washington.

"If you're convinced the Utah voice needs to be heard, rooted in the Utah experience, join me in supporting Ally Isom."
|

When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I_ _need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. The question is: _What will you do next?_ Will you delete this email and go back to your day waiting around for them to take away your next freedom? Maybe your second and first amendment rights next? Or will you [click the link, make a donation, and be part of the true grassroots movement that is building here](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60560727:JqAE9xoNr:m:1:3317145305:8A5EA4B8CEDF300D44CA91CAC3C9F255:r)? I've made it clear where I stand. I will not back down. I will not stop defending OUR rights. Yours and mine. I need you to commit, right now. Click the link, make as generous a donation as you can. **They want us silent. They want us on our knees.** Stand up. Stand with me. Get involved right now, while there is still time.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abettertn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abettertn]
Hi Friend,
Tennessee has the 4th lowest median income and has the highest bankruptcy rate in the country. There is no scenario where Tennessee flourishes if we do not raise the floor for marginalized communities and invest in people.
The most efficient way to improve the quality of life for people who live in marginalized communities is to raise the minimum wage. This will move Tennessee out of the basement when it comes to poverty statistics and into a future where Tennesseans thrive.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abettertn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abettertn]
The role of government is to provide for the general welfare of its people. Far too many people in our state work several jobs, but still struggle to make the ends meet. We must plan to move our state forward which includes making our state attractive to new industries while investing in small businesses as well as our most precious asset- the people. body:
I wrote an op-ed that appeared in The Washington Post earlier this week about how and why I changed my position on our nation’s gun laws after the Sandy Hook massacre. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46357242/349922524/-744169294?refcode=Header&ms=Header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGExNjgwYi1jZWU4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pzNEbouvgZJHn6Evg-PlPJlIMlT6ATOMnrSCLWUDGmQ=&emci=3f4a8704-2ae8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=d0a1680b-cee8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725) Peter,

I wrote an op-ed that appeared in _The Washington Post_ earlier this week about how and why I changed my position on our nation’s gun laws after the Sandy Hook massacre. I wanted to make sure you saw it and I ask you to please share it with your friends and family. This is a critical moment in our country’s history. The Senate can wait no longer to act on commonsense gun reforms. Our children are depending on us.

[Read my op-ed here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46357243/349922525/317778112?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGExNjgwYi1jZWU4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pzNEbouvgZJHn6Evg-PlPJlIMlT6ATOMnrSCLWUDGmQ=&emci=3f4a8704-2ae8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=d0a1680b-cee8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725)

Thank you,

Bob

_I’m a U.S. Senator who has done something rare in today’s politics: I’ve changed my position on our nation’s gun laws. After doing so, I didn’t burst into flames or get run out of town. That’s how I know others can choose to do the same._

_I came to Washington in 2007 with the firm belief that to support and honor Pennsylvania’s deep-rooted hunting culture meant that I should not support restrictions on gun sales or increased regulations._

_Then, in 2012, Sandy Hook happened. Twenty 6- and 7-year-olds and six educators were killed in their school by a 20-year-old with an assault rifle, just before Christmas._

_I will never forget the shock, horror and grief of learning that 26 families would never see their loved ones again. I was struck by the stark realization that we did not have to live like this. So I changed my position. Now it’s time for many of my colleagues in the Senate to do the same._

I’m still angry. I’m angry that we’ve reached a point where the Supreme Court has been hijacked by right-wing extremists and is preparing to impose their deeply unpopular views upon the rest of our country by overturning _Roe v. Wade_. I’m angry that Republicans have scheming this for decades, by stacking the Court, passing state law after state law to shred abortion rights, and plotting nationwide abortion bans if they are back in the majority. I’m angry because of who will be hurt the most by this decision, including communities of color and low-income women who cannot afford to simply travel to another state for an abortion if their state outlaws it. I’m angry. But we are not powerless. We can still fight back. And we must. I’m going to keep speaking out on the bold measures we need to immediately take to stop this injustice — like ending the filibuster to codify Roe into federal law and expanding the Supreme Court. But we’ve also got to build stronger pro-abortion rights majorities to get this done — and support candidates who will defend abortion rights at the state and local level. If you’re angry like I am that the Supreme Court has gotten this far out of sync with American values, own your anger. Channel it. clean_body: We are not powerless. We can fight back. | | | I’m still angry. I’m angry that we’ve reached a point where the Supreme Court has been hijacked by right-wing extremists and is preparing to impose their deeply unpopular views upon the rest of our country by overturning Roe v. Wade. I’m angry that Republicans have scheming this for decades, by stacking the Court, passing state law after state law to shred abortion rights, and plotting nationwide abortion bans if they are back in the majority. I’m angry because of who will be hurt the most by this decision, including communities of color and low-income women who cannot afford to simply travel to another state for an abortion if their state outlaws it. I’m angry. But we are not powerless. We can still fight back. And we must. I’m going to keep speaking out on the bold measures we need to immediately take to stop this injustice — like ending the filibuster to codify Roe into federal law and expanding the Supreme Court. But we’ve also got to build stronger pro-abortion rights majorities to get this done — and support candidates who will defend abortion rights at the state and local level. If you’re angry like I am that the Supreme Court has gotten this far out of sync with American values, own your anger. There are only five months until Election Day, and the importance of this election cannot be overstated. Our Governor, one of our U.S. Senators, and the makeup of the state legislature are all on the ballot.
It's never too early to make a plan to vote. Mark your calendars with these important election dates, and make sure your friends and family are registered to vote this Fall.

Lawyer Who Plotted to Overturn Trump Loss Recruits Election Deniers to Watch Over the Vote | The New York Times [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/30/us/politics/republican-poll-monitors-election-activists.html]
A central figure in the scheme to reverse the 2020 election is mobilizing grass-roots activists into an “army of citizens” trained to aggressively monitor elections. Read more. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/30/us/politics/republican-poll-monitors-election-activists.html]
Supreme Court has 30 opinions remaining in one-month sprint to end controversial term | CNN [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/05/politics/supreme-court-june-opinions/index.html]
As the Supreme Court rounds the final weeks of the term it has yet to decide an unusually high number of cases including disputes over abortion, gun rights, religious liberty, immigration and the environment – issues that deeply divide the public and exacerbate the ideological split on the 6-3 conservative-liberal court. Read More. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/05/politics/supreme-court-june-opinions/index.html]
Proponents of the “Big Lie” want to control the outcome of the next election | Penn Live [https://www.pennlive.com/opinion/2022/06/proponents-of-the-big-lie-want-to-control-the-outcome-of-the-next-election-opinion.html]
Last month, Pennsylvania Republicans nominated a candidate for governor who helped lead the efforts to overturn the presidential election of 2020. State Sen. Doug Mastriano is unapologetic about his role in the Jan. 6 march on the Capitol. In fact, he continues to use it as a rallying cry for his election-denying base. Read more. [https://www.pennlive.com/opinion/2022/06/proponents-of-the-big-lie-want-to-control-the-outcome-of-the-next-election-opinion.html]
Elections: Open Primaries and Runoffs | Politics PA [https://www.politicspa.com/elections-open-primaries-and-runoffs/106708/?emci=baacdbb3-5de7-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=1068162]
According to the Pennsylvania Department of State, nearly 1.1 million voters are registered as unaffiliated with a political party or with a third party. This segment of the state’s electorate has been increasing for years, consistent with a national trend of voters identifying as independents. Read more [https://www.politicspa.com/elections-open-primaries-and-runoffs/106708/?emci=baacdbb3-5de7-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=1068162] .

The Pennsylvania State Senate passed a controversial bill on Monday that changes rules governing poll watchers under the guise of ‘election integrity.' Read more [https://www.politicspa.com/election-integrity-puts-election-judges-in-crosshairs/107317/] .
Republicans face decision on constitutional changes package | AP News [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-voting-rights-constitutional-amendments-constitutions-951650d39ac2e5ffef9252e06743ce73]
“Some of the pending proposals reflect frustration among legislative Republicans with the state’s Democratic-majority state Supreme Court: to elect judges by geographic districts rather than statewide to boost rural Republican-dominated areas; to require judges to run for reelection; and to cut judicial terms to six years.“ Read more [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-voting-rights-constitutional-amendments-constitutions-951650d39ac2e5ffef9252e06743ce73] .
The Supreme Court Keeps Chipping Away at Your Constitutional Rights | New Republic [https://newrepublic.com/article/166725/thomas-bivens-boule-egbert-decision]
If you are a federal agent who enjoys violating the constitutional rights of other people, the Supreme Court gave you some good news on Wednesday. Read more. [https://newrepublic.com/article/166725/thomas-bivens-boule-egbert-decision]
Bob Casey: I changed my stance on guns. I shouldn’t be the only one. (Opinion) | The Washington Post [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2022/06/08/bob-casey-senator-changed-stance-on-guns/]
I’m a U.S. senator who has done something rare in today’s politics: I’ve changed my position on our nation’s gun laws. After doing so, I didn’t burst into flames or get run out of town. That’s how I know others can choose to do the same. Read more. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2022/06/08/bob-casey-senator-changed-stance-on-guns/]

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: The public hearings into Jan. 6 have begun
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=BM9xWbJzY3IeB%2BlhzpsuiYOs%2FZ6mSQzU&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
The January 6 investigative committee just held its first public hearing, laying out a damning case against Donald Trump for inciting a riot to stop the peaceful constitutional transfer of power to Joe Biden, the duly elected president.
The evidence so far paints a clear and disturbing picture:
* Despite a total lack of evidence for the claim, Donald Trump spent weeks spreading the Big Lie that Joe Biden's rightful victory in the 2020 election was due to fraud.
* Trump whipped his supporters into a frenzy, culminating in a January 6 rally in Washington -- Trump invited them, he incited them, and then he encouraged them to march on the Capitol.
* According to one eyewitness account, Trump "gleefully" watched news coverage on a White House TV as the attacks on the Capitol unfolded - even rewinding at times to watch certain moments again and again.
* For hours as the insurrection unfolded, Trump refused to issue a public statement calling on his violent supporters to stand down. On the day of the attack, there is a _seven-hour gap_ in the White House telephone logs - a giant, lingering question mark over whom Trump was communicating with as the attacks unfolded and whether the Trump White House attempted to cover up that information.

This is just the first of six planned public hearings in which the committee will present findings from over 100,000 documents collected and more than 1,000 interviews conducted - including those with top Trump administration officials and members of Trump's own family.
**But while the committee will continue its public hearings and deliver the truth that the American people deserve, CNN reports that Donald Trump and his supporters on Capitol Hill are waging an all-out defense to "protect" the former president during the hearings and launching a full-court press to discredit the hearings on Fox News and other right-wing media outlets.**
**[Extremist Republicans will stop at nothing to defend their disgraced leader. We MUST raise our voices to ensure the GOP's spin efforts fall short and Trump is finally held accountable. In the wake of these hearings, we need to hear from grassroots Democrats like you loudly and clearly: Add your name immediately if you think that Donald Trump should be held accountable for his role in the Jan 6. insurrection.](http://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-jan-6?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1194-su-nd)**
Thank you for speaking out for our democracy,
Dick

More than two dozen Georgia voters, would-be voters, poll watchers, and community leaders have testified during the trial about their commitment to voting and the barriers they faced in the registration process, trying to cast a ballot, and trying to get their ballot counted. Throughout the trial, Fair Fight Action has asked the Court to adopt remedies that will reduce the burdens Georgia voters experience trying to register and vote, including:
* Ending Georgia’s “Exact Match” registration policy that places eligible voters, disproportionately voters of color, in a different status than other active voters;
* Requiring a citizenship check process that allows eligible U.S. citizens to register to vote without wrongly excluding new Americans and people of color;
* Ensuring the accuracy and effectiveness of the state’s training on the procedures for canceling absentee ballots to allow a voter to vote in person; and
* Ensuring efficient, just, and fair elections across Georgia.

This lawsuit, while focused on transforming the elections system in Georgia to support all eligible voters and comply with federal law, is one that Fair Fight Action believes will set precedent and further pave the way for free and fair elections nationwide. subject: Proud to be endorsed by Giffords
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Team —

Today, Giffords PAC endorsed our campaign for Congress. Let me tell you why this is important to me.

Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords epitomizes courage. After a gunman severely injured her in an assassination attempt, she could have backed down.

Instead, she founded Giffords, one of the largest advocates for gun safety in the country. Today, I’m honored to have their support and honored to stand with Congresswoman Giffords in the fight for gun safety legislation.

When the tragic shooting in Uvalde happened, my mind immediately traveled back to Parkland in 2018. In the wake of unspeakable tragedy, I passed the most comprehensive gun violence prevention legislation in Florida history.

Now, we need to do the same in Washington. I’m looking forward to partnering with Giffords, Moms Demand Action, Fred Guttenberg, and gun safety advocates from across the country to get this done.

We’ve remained in this cycle for far too long: a mass shooting, followed by mass outrage, followed by inaction.

I’m running for Congress because I’m tired of excuses. It’s time for Washington to step up and deliver comprehensive, meaningful gun safety legislation.

Thank you for joining Giffords and thousands of others in supporting our fight.

With Gratitude,

Jared Moskowitz

| | **CALLING ALL WOMEN LEADERS!!** **Applications are now open for Hoosier Women Forward Class 5!** ** ** **WHO WE ARE**
**Hoosier Women Forward** is a political and civic leadership training program designed to empower Democratic women to become more active participants in politics and leaders in their communities. **OUR GOALS**
* Empower Democratic women to become more active, confident and valuable participants in politics and community leadership;
* Grow a powerful network of engaged Democratic women across Indiana;
* Develop Democratic women to run for office at the local, state and federal levels;
* Increase the number of Hoosier Democratic women of influence in every level of government, and in seats at the tables where decisions are made.

## WHAT WE DO
## Each year, a group of outstanding Democratic women will be selected through a competitive application process to participate in a nine-month leadership training program. Applications go live each year in May and we accept no more than 24 women.
## Democratic women with a demonstrated ability to take initiative in their communities or places of work and are encouraged to apply. Applicants should have an interest in public policy, advancing Indiana forward with progressive ideas, and be committed to increasing women’s influence in the political process. HWF is not a candidate training program, you do not need to be interested in running for office to be selected for our program.
HWF alumnae are well on our way to helping to elevate more women in positions of leadership in the public, private and non-profit sectors. We are excited to watch our newest alumnae grow and support each other on their continued leadership paths. By the end of this month, HWF will celebrate 89 women completing the program. If you want to be part of the next Hoosier Women Forward class, apply by June 22nd. Please read the eligibility information and instructions carefully to make sure this is the right program and right time for you.
Applications must be submitted online, and all of the information can be found at [https://hoosierwomenforward.org/apply/](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46361765/349942610/1772549238?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2ExYTU3NC1kNmU4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fPePX2ZtV7KeeqKNA4psl0sFOy4kj9sekzjLKelNQk0=&emci=b3b854a9-b3e8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a7a1a574-d6e8-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) If you know someone who fits our applicant qualifications, please forward this email to them and encourage them to apply! name: Jackson Lahmeyer
subject: Who Is Jackson Lahmeyer Running Against James Lankford For US Senate?
body:
In Oklahoma, people are seeing "Lahmeyer For Senate" signs, billboards, ads and etc... scattered throughout all 77 counties. All of these signs cause
| | |
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6551.1.754312521def46dc666c70b84a69ae72)
---
In Oklahoma, people are seeing **"Lahmeyer For Senate"** signs, billboards, ads and etc... scattered throughout all 77 counties. All of these signs cause _curiosity_ : **"Who Is Jackson Lahmeyer?"** If you read the _Washington Post_ you will get the impression that I'm a threat to democracy; if you read the _[Oklahoma City Sentine](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6552.1.6691cb68528c9e09ef3065c39f04b9a7)l_ you will get the impression that I'm a Patriot endorsed by National Leaders such as **General Michael Flynn** , **Roger Stone** , Mayor Rudy Giuliani, **Mike Lindell** and others including organizations such as the Oklahoma Second Amendemnet Association, Oklahomans For Health & Parental Rights and the Oil & Gas Workers Association. I figured that I should write to you and let you know who I really am and what my background is. I'm **definitely not** a _Career Politician_ or a _Washinton Insider_. I'm a 4th generation Oklahoman from the Claremore area. I started my first of many businesses at the age of 15. That first business I started was a simple Lawn Care that still operates today. I attended **Oral Roberts University** (ORU) and received a B.A. & M.A. in Theological & Historical Studies graduating Magna Cum Laude. While at ORU, I served as a Youth Pastor at a few different local churches that gave me the opportunity to get my start in ministry. Upon graduation from ORU, I stepped in as the Crusade Director for **Christ for All Nations** , the ministry of **Reinhard Bonnke** that has helped lead 74,000,000 people to Christ since 1974. While serving as the Crusade Director, I also became the Oklahoma State Coordinator for the **Billy Graham Evangelistic Association** (a position I held for 5 years). In 2017, my wife, Kendra, and I were honored to become the Lead Pastors of the historic **Sheridan Christian Center** in Tulsa, OK – now known as [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6553.1.8e7e284a0b4093302205afc2022c9aa3). [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6554.1.eaf32956fbb728a88f73a264dfc6ccbe)was founded in 1951 and has been one of the most influential churches in the state of Oklahoma with 30 other churches and ministries being planted out of it. Some of those churches and ministries include: **Victory.Church** in Tulsa, **Rhema Bible Training Center** in Broken Arrow, **Eastland Assembly of God** in Tulsa, **Trinity Bible College** and so many more. While pastoring [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6555.1.ffbe0f4e02d9f9020e714a7ae2c852e0), I've also been an Instructor of Theology at **Victory College** from 2017 to 2021 and in 2019, I served as the interim Dean of Theology at **Victory College** while they transitioned in leadership. The Lord has been very good to me professionally with the opportunities He has given me but the Lord has been even better to me with the family He has given me. My wife, Kendra, and I are very grateful for the _basketball team_ of 5 kids we get to raise and train up.
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6556.1.983ff9c8e8f8563df8596e1541e65f1b)
---
We currently live in Owasso, OK right outside Tulsa.
It was a little more than a year ago that **Kendra** and **General Michael Flynn** nudged me to run for the US Senate in Oklahoma to challenge and replace [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6557.1.44404d1e4ed344452e9749bd5c22f66d).
I get asked quite often, "_Why are you running_?"
**I am running to finish President Trump's border wall.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6558.1.4c4b50ae278d872c2ff596a6a8dbd820) mocked President Trump's border wall.
**I am running against Joe Biden's socialist agenda.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6559.1.dc0968a5ec0b6f6d3b39a6bf2290def5) votes with the Biden Administration over 51% of the time.
**I am running to defend the Second Amendment.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6560.1.e50235497547af622a7e3c0de3ba96c5) has an "F rating" from Gun Owners of America.
**I am running against the radical Left's cancel culture.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6561.1.5d745cc28f05ef855182c456844a07ba) caved to the radical Left and proposed renaming our military bases.
**I am running to investigate the 2020 election.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11139086.6562.1.d5ac179c9bd895aaee9a3a1d7de2ec73) voted to certify the 2020 election.
**I am running to put AMERICA FIRST!**

Dear Friend,
This past week, the Fiscal Alliance Foundation released a poll of Massachusetts voters. As you might have seen in a previous e-mail from my campaign, the poll included some good news: I am currently leading my primary opponent by a margin of 33-3.
However, it's actually another poll question that has me thinking the most.
For the first time I can remember, the poll asked voters if they have any plans of perhaps moving away from Massachusetts and living somewhere else. Sadly, about one-quarter of respondents said yes.
---
HELP GEOFF MAKE MASSACHUSETTS A PLACE TO LIVE, NOT LEAVE
---
| [Click Here to Donate Now](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JbjdGVxW9oRRB-HIpqdr2x_cJu2fiXC6o2byj_s-3jasVvlKHsZnFkXkDZLq3CCQWcuKpD7n_02WhR3m0Mkv_0308L06fWMbWr-f7784gdVxLVp3AjuqMTno3wgx2G1lEqq4-C1Sxw-QzjFVgB4GjP4fc_0ft5ZlEg0moF5okqLLhjUw72wDWA==&c=wj2a9nS2VQWA8oJHrnkD_gNa4S3pKJImb6lVfw6_QYkgJuTeHagDNQ==&ch=Y6yx0noid9-k_DTjuG4nKWaPwkGDmtb-PwKpGTDADI42JeyEVIKu8A==)
---
Consider what happened just this week:

* Gas \- Despite the fact the average price of gas has now soared past $5 per gallon statewide (and rising), the Legislature still refuses to suspend our state gas tax. I've called for a gas tax suspension repeatedly, and yet Democrats refer to such proposals as a "gimmick" and a "stunt". Think about that the next time you fill up at the pumps.

* Business \- This week one of our state's leading employers, Raytheon, announced its decision to move its corporate headquarters from Massachusetts to Virginia. I want to make our state a place where people want to live and work, not leave. And yet, the Legislature refuses to address glaring issues with our state's finances that threaten substantial business tax increases next year. That could cause more employers to either follow suit and leave, or worse, close their doors completely.

* Illegal Immigration \- The House and Senate enacted a bill to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants living in Massachusetts. This action was taken notwithstanding direct warnings from Governor Baker that the Registry of Motor Vehicles is not capable of accurately evaluating the identity of applicants, and that giving out licenses threatens the integrity of our elections. I have consistently opposed this bill and I support a ballot question to repeal it.

What was Maura Healey's response to all of this? You guessed it:
---
---
|
---
| It's clear that having a Governor who will stand up and say no is an important line of defense when it comes to your rights, your freedoms, and your prosperity.
I was proud to stand up for taxpayers in 2014, when we successfully collected 100,000 signatures and waged a successful ballot campaign against permanent increases in the state gas tax tied to the rate of inflation. Drivers across our state have saved money at the pumps ever since. I am equally proud to stand up for the rights of taxpayers today, and I will continue to fight for your rights as your next Governor.
I will always be on your side.
Can I count on you to help me win this race?

# [URGENT: Tennessee Christian Foster Home in the Crosshairs. They Need Your Help!](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | |
Dear Fellow American,

It’s a sad day when the federal government tries to force faith-based ministries to surrender their beliefs or stop serving vulnerable children.

But that day has come.

The Biden administration has revived an Obama-era rule requiring faith-based ministries to violate their biblical beliefs if they participate in a reimbursement program for adoption and foster-care providers.

**This is simply another way for the government to stamp out beliefs it doesn’t like.**

The rule forces ministries to place children in homes that don’t align with the ministry’s faith. And for organizations like Holston United Methodist Home for Children, which has been serving homeless children since 1895, this is simply untenable.

The organization I lead, Alliance Defending Freedom (ADF), has filed a lawsuit against the Biden administration in federal court challenging the rule on behalf of Holston Home.

Right now, Holston Home’s case is pending before a U.S. District Court. We’re committed to defending ministries like Holston Home all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court, if necessary. And we need your help.

[Today, I’m writing to ask you to stand behind Holston Home’s legal defense.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._1SoXa4jPltYQfWOzyFg)

We never charge our clients a dime for our legal services. But that’s only possible because people like you give to support their defense. Your gift right now will be 100% tax-deductible!

---
| | [GIVE NOW](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| |
## Holston Home and other ministries live out the Gospel
---
Ministries like Holston Home are forces for good, living out the words of Christ to care for children and "the least of these."

As renowned Christian singer and songwriter Steven Curtis Chapman has said, “Adoption is the perfect picture of what God has done for each of us in making us His children through Christ.”

The same can be said for foster care and related services to vulnerable children.

Countless kids come through ministries like Holston Home, facing situations that no child should ever have to go through. With what they’ve endured, many are afraid to trust.

But because of these ministries, they can be loved and learn to trust again. And sometimes, praise God, their moms and dads turn their lives around—and they can be reunited as a family.

Holston Home wants to help children and adults overcome generations of dysfunction and pain. And they know that any lasting change is a true work of God.

[That’s what your gift today will help protect](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)—the ability of Holston Home to minister to hurting families.

| | [DONATE NOW](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._ZECidiUv3N9ip7oFcrM5g)
---

## Right now, Holston Home needs YOUR help

The current move by the Biden administration to eject ministries like Holston Home from the program doesn’t just violate their God-given right to religious freedom. It also ignores a recent U.S. Supreme Court ruling that upheld the rights of a faith-based foster care agency in Philadelphia to operate according to its convictions.

But, most importantly, it hurts children that need help the most.

It’s vital that Holston Home, as a religious organization, remains free to continue placing at-risk children in loving, Christian families, according to its deeply held beliefs. And it shouldn't have to fear government penalties to do so.

**I assure you, we are committed to challenge this rule all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court, if necessary.**

Politicizing foster care and adoption makes it harder for children to find stable, permanent homes. That’s inevitable when the government tries to force faith-based providers to check their beliefs at the door.

But we won’t accept that. Will you?

[Please give today](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-ra0zOf5ij_4dSmMZGA) to help defend Holston Home and challenge the Biden administration’s anti-religion action.

| [DONATE](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._dJ5-8eyXKYYLGA)
---

Blessings and thanks,

---

Michael Farris
President & CEO

By [making a gift to help defend Holston Home today](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._U02lzBa7Adg), you’ll help ensure that vulnerable children have the opportunity to find loving, Christian homes!

clean_body: | | Please see a special message from our sponsor. | | | | | | | | Dear Fellow American, It’s a sad day when the federal government tries to force faith-based ministries to surrender their beliefs or stop serving vulnerable children. But that day has come. The Biden administration has revived an Obama-era rule requiring faith-based ministries to violate their biblical beliefs if they participate in a reimbursement program for adoption and foster-care providers. This is simply another way for the government to stamp out beliefs it doesn’t like. The rule forces ministries to place children in homes that don’t align with the ministry’s faith. And for organizations like Holston United Methodist Home for Children, which has been serving homeless children since 1895, this is simply untenable. The organization I lead, Alliance Defending Freedom (ADF), has filed a lawsuit against the Biden administration in federal court challenging the rule on behalf of Holston Home. Right now, Holston Home’s case is pending before a U.S. District Court. We’re committed to defending ministries like Holston Home all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court, if necessary. And we need your help. We never charge our clients a dime for our legal services. But that’s only possible because people like you give to support their defense. Your gift right now will be 100% tax-deductible! | | | | Holston Home and other ministries live out the Gospel Ministries like Holston Home are forces for good, living out the words of Christ to care for children and "the least of these." As renowned Christian singer and songwriter Steven Curtis Chapman has said, “Adoption is the perfect picture of what God has done for each of us in making us His children through Christ.” The same can be said for foster care and related services to vulnerable children. Countless kids come through ministries like Holston Home, facing situations that no child should ever have to go through. With what they’ve endured, many are afraid to trust. But because of these ministries, they can be loved and learn to trust again. And sometimes, praise God, their moms and dads turn their lives around—and they can be reunited as a family. Holston Home wants to help children and adults overcome generations of dysfunction and pain. And they know that any lasting change is a true work of God. —the ability of Holston Home to minister to hurting families. | | Right now, Holston Home needs YOUR help The current move by the Biden administration to eject ministries like Holston Home from the program doesn’t just violate their God-given right to religious freedom. It also ignores a recent U.S. Supreme Court ruling that upheld the rights of a faith-based foster care agency in Philadelphia to operate according to its convictions. But, most importantly, it hurts children that need help the most. It’s vital that Holston Home, as a religious organization, remains free to continue placing at-risk children in loving, Christian families, according to its deeply held beliefs. And it shouldn't have to fear government penalties to do so. I assure you, we are committed to challenge this rule all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court, if necessary. Politicizing foster care and adoption makes it harder for children to find stable, permanent homes. That’s inevitable when the government tries to force faith-based providers to check their beliefs at the door. But we won’t accept that. Will you? to help defend Holston Home and challenge the Biden administration’s anti-religion action. | Blessings and thanks, Michael Farris President & CEO By , you’ll help ensure that vulnerable children have the opportunity to find loving, Christian homes! | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- © 2022 Alliance Defending Freedom 15100 N. 90th Street, Scottsdale, Arizona 85260 All donations are secure, private, and tax-deductible. Mass shootings are not inevitable – we can prevent a great deal of gun violence by not allowing weapons to end up in the hands of those who intend to do harm. In 2020, guns became the leading cause of death for children and teens. We must do better – our children deserve a safer country to grow up in. We’re fed up with Congress’ inaction. We need background checks immediately. No more “thoughts and prayers.” Too many lives have been lost to senseless gun violence. name: Brandon Wolf, Pulse Survivor
subject: The day my life changed forever....
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Pride Fund to End Gun Violence PAC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Peter,

I’m alive, but will forever be haunted by that tragic night at Pulse nightclub 6 years ago on Sunday.

Seconds before it happened, we were all dancing to the pulse of the thundering music from the DJ. My boyfriend Eric and I had just left our friends, Drew and Juan, to go to the bathroom. That’s when we heard the first gunshots.

People began piling into the red-tinted bathroom, the scent of blood clinging to their clothes. We thought we were going to die, crouching in terror in a bathroom stall. We huddled there until we were able to charge through the smoke toward the fire exit. We didn’t look back. We didn’t want to see anything. We just ran for that door.

Sunday will make six years ago. I’m alive — I was one of the lucky ones, but 49 innocent, beautiful souls were taken. The hundreds of us inside Pulse couldn’t stop a murderer with the ability to buy an automatic assault rifle designed for warfare with a surplus of ammunition.

That’s why I joined the Board of Advisors for Pride Fund to End Gun Violence. Our mission is to turn tragedy into action through a focus on common sense gun safety reforms like enacting background checks and restricting access to assault weapons and high-capacity magazines. Our organization relies solely on donations from grassroots donors like you. This work is critical and I am asking for your donation. Friend, will you pitch in to help us save lives? https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-brandon-6years?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

My best friends were failed by our political system. It failed the families of the 49 people who were killed, the 53 people who were injured, and all of the survivors like me who were permanently scarred by the attack. Politicians chose the gun lobby over public safety. The system failed me and it’s currently failing all of us. That’s why I need your help.

Let’s honor my friends, Drew and Juan, and the 47 others by taking action. Pride Fund is working to honor all of those whose lives were taken by senseless gun violence by standing up to the gun lobby, electing candidates who support gun safety laws and LGBTQ equality, and speaking out to save lives.

Friend, I hope you’ll join me in our fight to save lives. Click here to support our mission. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-brandon-6years?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

With appreciation,

Brandon Wolf

Pulse Survivor

Pride Fund Board of Advisors Member

DONATE: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-brandon-6years?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

To help us grow this movement, will you please forward this email to 2 friends to get them involved?

Our mission is to turn tragedy into action through a focus on common sense gun safety reforms like enacting background checks and restricting access to assault weapons and high-capacity magazines. Our organization relies solely on donations from grassroots donors like you. This work is critical and I am asking for your donation. Friend, will you pitch in to help us save lives? My best friends were failed by our political system. It failed the families of the 49 people who were killed, the 53 people who were injured, and all of the survivors like me who were permanently scarred by the attack. Politicians chose the gun lobby over public safety. The system failed me and it’s currently failing all of us. That’s why I need your help. Let’s honor my friends, Drew and Juan, and the 47 others by taking action. Pride Fund is working to honor all of those whose lives were taken by senseless gun violence by standing up to the gun lobby, electing candidates who support gun safety laws and LGBTQ equality, and speaking out to save lives. Friend, I hope you’ll join me in our fight to save lives. Click here to support our mission. clean_body: When I returned home from my last deployment in Afghanistan in January 2021, I had faith in our leaders to control the situation and support our men a| | | Peter, When I returned home from my last deployment in Afghanistan in January 2021, I had faith in our leaders to control the situation and support our men and women in uniform. But just months later, I watched Joe Biden hand over Kabul to terrorists and leave our service members in the dust. I had seen this story before - and I knew it wasn’t good. My family escaped Vietnam after the fall of Saigon and were fortunate enough to legally immigrate to the United States. Afghanistan today looks a lot like Vietnam when we left, and I wasn’t going to sit by idly while weak leaders let history repeat itself. Joe Biden’s unforgivable failure in Afghanistan inspired me to run for Congress and step up for America when our Commander in Chief won’t. We need a leader who will put a check on Joe Biden’s foreign policy. And after over 20 years serving alongside special forces in the Navy, I know I’m up to the challenge. Now, I just need your endorsement. subject: How We Can Keep Ohio a Manufacturing Hub

| |

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Nancy Pelosi is going all-in against us in our next primary
body:
We knew that Kina would be heavily outspent, but we didn’t expect Nancy Pelosi to jump in last September, so early on in the race, to chase down big donations for Davis.
#
Peter — Nancy Pelosi is going all-in against us in our next primary. She’s backing corporate Democrat Danny Davis against progressive fighter and Justice Democrat, Kina Collins.
She _just_ recorded a campaign video for Davis — and we think Pelosi will turn this into a robocall to send directly to voters.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110431?refcode=em20220610-23773&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL)
Pelosi did the same thing against us last month, in support of conservative, anti-abortion Democrat Henry Cuellar.
Nancy Pelosi is campaigning and raising money for Davis, because she knows that Kina Collins is a formidable primary opponent. **_But we can’t raise the type of mega donor dollars that Pelosi can._** [Will you donate directly to Kina Collins’ campaign so we can defeat the establishment and send Kina to Congress? Her primary in IL-7 is in just 18 days.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110431?refcode=em20220610-23773&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110431?refcode=em20220610-23773&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL)**
We can’t let corporate Democrats out-spend us so heavily to edge out a victory — we know they’ll go all-out to stop us. We must send as much grassroots support to Kina as we can.
Kina Collins is running to be a representative of the people — and unlike Congressman Davis, she won’t fight for the interests of health insurance companies, the real estate industry, and big corporations. We knew that Kina would be heavily outspent, but we didn’t expect Nancy Pelosi to jump in last September, so early on in the race, to chase down big donations for Davis.
Nancy Pelosi made it clear that the Democratic establishment backs Danny Davis 100% and will fight to keep him in Congress. Just like she did against us in TX-28 to boost Cuellar.
**We can’t let corporate Democrats defeat us in IL-7.** [Can you donate to Kina’s campaign right now so she has the resources to win against the Democratic establishment?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110431?refcode=em20220610-23773&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL)
Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary candidates.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=24&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=25&akid=23773%2E1203867%2E4paJPL) and your state public health department.
---

Trump and his team knew the election wasn’t stolen.
Trump incited his supporters, including the Proud Boys and Oath Keepers, to storm the Capitol to overturn the election.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Please. Keep. Moving. Forward.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
In life and in work, the greatest successes are almost always the product of a series of small steps.
#

Friends - In life and in work, the greatest successes are almost always the product of a series of small steps.
I’ve found that true in my recovery, and in our work to fix our gun laws.
There are setbacks—some minor, some almost impossible to bear. And there are victories—some that go largely unnoticed, and others that feel transformational.
Each requires us to resist complacency and recommit ourselves to keep moving forward.
It's easy to look at our federal gun laws and say nothing has changed since Sandy Hook—or to be skeptical about the potential for change after Uvalde.
But please let me assure you, if you look at our work and the way the ground is shifting in states across the country, we're getting closer ... much closer.
This year presents an important opportunity for us. Either the Senate will vote to make our communities safer from gun violence, or we will need to elect a Congress that will.
We can do it. And campaigning on the issue of preventing gun violence is how we’ll get it done.
But I need your help, and these emails help fund our work. So please:

Folks,

I’ll never forget January 6, 2021, when a mob of insurrectionists stormed the U.S. Capitol, seeking to overturn the results of a fair and free election. They were incited by false claims that the 2020 presidential election was stolen, false claims that Gov. Ron DeSantis _refuses_ to denounce. **To this day, he still won’t admit the election was legitimate. Nor will DeSantis condemn the attack on our Capitol.**

In my view, it isn’t just disqualifying; it’s downright _dangerous_. We need to take threats to our democracy seriously. Ron DeSantis refuses to condemn the attack, he refuses to say that Joe Biden won the 2020 presidential election, and he refuses to investigate Florida-based hate groups that were involved in the insurrection.

**_[I’m ready to defeat Ron DeSantis in November. Will you donate to help me restore truth and leadership to Tallahassee?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46373176/349972673/-1259897921?amount=25&refcode=20220610_f_rr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTE1MzFmYi1lOWU4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EgjR_nCZ4465M5abaytlBAKTfGDxWKqyuf-Bij1aGcw=)_**

As the tragic events of January 6th proved, claiming that a legitimate election was rigged isn’t a joke. These partisan lies led to real-world harm, and there is no room in our state or our country for that kind of rhetoric.

Ron DeSantis is focused on building a national platform and profile so he can run for president in 2024, so he doesn’t care what lies he spouts or misinformation he amplifies; it’s all red meat for his far-right base.

Words matter, and Floridians deserve the unvarnished truth from their governor. Ron DeSantis refuses to speak that truth. **_[Will you make a donation to my campaign? I’ll always stand up for what’s right as governor, but I can’t defeat Ron DeSantis without your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46373177/349972674/-1259897921?amount=25&refcode=20220610_f_rr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OTE1MzFmYi1lOWU4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EgjR_nCZ4465M5abaytlBAKTfGDxWKqyuf-Bij1aGcw=)_**

Charlie Crist

#
Hey *|FNAME|*,

Welcome to my newsletter! I am Elizabeth "Liz" Johnson, and I can't wait to serve you as your congresswoman.

Things may seem smooth and easy for me now, but they weren't always that way. In fact, as a woman, wife, and mother, I may have often walked in your shoes.

My son once told me, "Mom, your story is not for you, so get over it! It's for those who can relate to it and inspire them. So now I am sharing my story to inspire you, hopefully.

As with any typical life-changing story, my story starts with love. I was married to my high school sweetheart, and I considered it the perfect love story at the time. I was head over heels in love with my husband and our beautiful children, but my world crashed around me after 20 years of marriage. I found myself divorced and depressed. I began to pray to God for something bigger than my situation to get my mind off my home life.

Sometimes we can give advice, but we don't always listen to our own advice. I remember listening to my colleagues in the insurance industry complain. I constantly asked them what are you going to do about it? "One night, I complained about my life and asked myself, "Liz, what are you going to do about it?". It was time for me to follow my own advice. At this moment, I got the idea to run for Insurance Commissioner of Florida. There was one small problem; I didn't know much about politics. I always considered myself a parent advocate, not a community advocate.

I didn't have the money to qualify for the ballot at the deadline. However, I still traveled to the Florida Department of State Division of Elections, intending to get on the ballot.

Guess what? I accomplished my goal as a write-in candidate! I didn't win, of course, but I was told I received the most votes as a Florida write-in candidate! That campaign lit a fire within me, but I still had to deal with my personal life.

As a newly divorced single mom with now only my nine-year-old son at home, my daily living became a struggle. Eventually, I moved to Georgia with my son to live in a mobile home park with my sister's family. After two months of moping around, the fire reignited within me, and I got a job with the largest insurance agency in the area. Soon after, I was able to move my youngest son and me to our new home. It is incredible what you can accomplish with determination and support.

Alright, that's all for today but if you would like to read more about me visit my [meet Liz page!](https://lizjohnsonforus.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4a0fd0913238344008dfe952&id=5699a6d7a2&e=e8eaba4639)

Please keep your eyes peeled for tomorrow's email, where I discuss how this campaign has been an uphill battle. See you soon!

With much gratitude,
Elizabeth "Liz" Johnson
Lizjohnsonforus.com

This EPA was a significant step toward equality. We must remember how far we've come, but there is still so much more to do: **gender pay gaps are _still_ a real problem in states across the country, and here in our district.**

While the legislation of the EPA was a great first step, it's time that we build upon it and grant greater protections to women, especially women of color who face the pay gap on a greater level.

We need to strive for true wage equality – for fair wages for all workers, from service workers to CEOs.

On average, women earn less than men, but they have to work longer hours for the same pay. This impacts how they can support themselves and their families and the quality of life they can have.

Women deserve better – our families and our communities deserve better, and we should all be paid equally.

Last year, the proposed **Paycheck Fairness Act** was passed in the House and is the type of progressive legislation necessary to address the gender pay gap across the country. Once it passes the Senate, this legislation would add procedural protections to the **Equal Pay Act of 1963** and the **Fair Labor Standards Act**. Bryan Steil voted with the Republicans against this piece of legislation. He does not believe that it is important for women to earn the same as men and that it is okay for employers to retaliate against and punish workers who share wage information.

We have to vote him out in November.
