While the legislation of the EPA was a great first step, it's time that we build upon it and grant greater protections to women, especially women of color who face the pay gap on a greater level. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = We need to strive for true wage equality – for fair wages for all workers, from service workers to CEOs. On average, women earn less than men, but they have to work longer hours for the same pay. This impacts how they can support themselves and their families and the quality of life they can have. Women deserve better – our families and our communities deserve better, and we should all be paid equally. Last year, the proposed Paycheck Fairness Act was passed in the House and is the type of progressive legislation necessary to address the gender pay gap across the country. Once it passes the Senate, this legislation would add procedural protections to the Equal Pay Act of 1963 and the Fair Labor Standards Act. Bryan Steil voted with the Republicans against this piece of legislation. He does not believe that it is important for women to earn the same as men and that it is okay for employers to retaliate against and punish workers who share wage information. We have to vote him out in November. = = Thank you for being a part of this fight, – Ann Roe = ** =

subject: I proudly voted gun safety legislation through the House because the time to act is NOW.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Peter,

We have seen unprecedented gun violence in our country, not just over the past week, but since the start of 2022.

None of us should grow accustomed to hearing a parent speak about planning their child's funeral. None of us should grow accustomed to seeing kids fleeing a school with their hands in the air during an active shooter situation. We should not simply accept this as life in America.

The horrendous acts of mass gun violence have taken the lives of countless Americans - including children and teachers - and so many more. Yet, many of my Republican colleagues have consistently blocked any meaningful, common-sense gun safety legislation.

This week, I supported two pieces of crucial legislation: The Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order Act and The Protecting Our Kids Act. If passed, these laws would undoubtedly prevent more senseless acts of violence. Here is what you need to know:

_**Federal Extreme Risk Protection Order Act:**_ Would allow family members and law enforcement to obtain an extreme risk protection order to temporarily remove access to firearms for those deemed a danger to themselves or others by a court.

_**Protecting Our Kids Act:**_ Would raise the legal age to purchase semi-automatic rifles, crack down on gun trafficking, establish safety measures for residential storage of dangerous firearms, and ban bump stocks, high-capacity magazines, and ghost guns. These acts would result in significant protections for all Americans. Now, it's up to the Senate to send them to the president's desk without delay.

subject: The Easiest Thing You'll Do All Year!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becky Edwards for U
body:
Voting shouldn't just be easy, it should be exciting! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6509dae65a64/the-easiest-thing-youll-do-all-year?e=10c1db3257)
---
| | [ ](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=50ba96e085&e=10c1db3257)
---
| |
---
| Friend,

Where did you **first learn about voting?** Was it in government class? Or U.S. History? Maybe you asked a friend, parent, or neighbor why they **wore the signature 'I voted' sticker.**

At some point, **we are all introduced to voting!** It's one of our country's **most foundational principles,** and while knowing you can vote at 18 is the **first step towards a life of civic engagement,** it can be difficult to know**how, when, or where** you can **make your voice heard. **

Our campaign has been **committed to civic education** since the beginning. With the **arrival of Republican primary ballots** across the state this week, I want to provide you with all the **information you need** to become a **confident and effective voter!**
---
| Before you fill out your ballot or head to the polls, it's important to remember that **any vote is a good vote! **Even if you only vote in the U.S. Senate race, **your voice makes a difference.**

With all of the state and local races happening this year, **taking a moment to learn about your local candidates** and thoroughly **filling out your ballot** can make a big difference for your community—and **it's easier than you think! **

You can**learn more about the elections happening in your area **[here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=d8023f95b4&e=10c1db3257) and find **local voter guides** by following our [civic education thread](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=cf5cf6c5cf&e=10c1db3257) on Twitter! Any vote is a good vote, **but an educated vote is better. **

With that, **here's what you need to know** for the upcoming primary on June 28th:
---
| | **HOW?**

Utah has a **closed Republican primary.** That means **only registered Republicans** are allowed to **vote in the primary election.** New and unaffiliated voters can **affiliate online at[vote.utah.gov](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=7ad88107fa&e=10c1db3257) until June 17th **and in-person until **election day, June 28th. **

If you register or affiliate online, the **last day to request a mail ballot is June 21st by 5 pm.** To register or affiliate in person, please bring at least **two forms of identification** to your polling location.
---
| | **WHEN AND WHERE?** **Mail-In Voting ** Republican primary ballots began arriving in mailboxes on June 7th. If you have already received your ballot, **fill it out and mail it back as soon as possible! **Don't put it aside with the rest of your mail; instead, **go for one-touch voting:** receive your ballot, fill it out, and **put it back in the mail. **

The **last day to mail your ballot back is June 27th,** just one day before the primary election. If you prefer to use a **secure ballot drop box,** you have until **8 pm on election day** to drop off your ballot. You can **find your county's drop box locations** [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=40692a0dcc&e=10c1db3257).

**In-Person Voting** Election day is **Tuesday, June 28th,** but each county has designated a **minimum of four days for early voting** the week before election day! You can **find your county's early voting** and election day **polling locations** [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=1e751c4970&e=10c1db3257).
---
| While serving in the Utah House of Representatives, **I took an oath to protect and defend the Constitution.** Five times, I committed to **protecting your right to vote.** I believe that **every Utahn deserves a voice** , and not only should voting be easy, **it should be exciting! **
---
|
---
| The chance to vote in a U.S. Senate race is rare. Every six years, **we have a chance to make a change,** but this year, we have an **especially unique opportunity** to bring **better leadership and better solutions** to Washington D.C.

Utah deserves a Senator who will **show up for Utahns, do the work, and get things done.** When the time comes for you to **fill out your ballot or head to the polls,** I know you'll make your voice heard, and**I humbly ask for your vote. **

As always, **thank you for your support. **

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkr3afai3ls0non49riemqnkib8k3mkr1lhmbvf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3geeor2cdh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zujl69rqbl22ld833tbvucmqpb33brd0g4pc4hq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ge9ob4c1h2bs) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we’ll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0n7r11is934nr19gcif58vdj376364h9usg21f8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ge9ob4c1h2bs) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zj7a1lb5ncer5mil1ed9qudmo8ggnmal1heqta0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ge9ob4c1h2bs)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

This week, the House of Representatives advanced one of the largest gun control packages ever to be advanced out of a chamber of congress.

After being rushed through Pelosi's House of Representatives, HR 7910 and HR 2377 are now on their way to Chuck Schumer and the United States Senate.

And with new reports of Republican Senators participating in back-room negotiations with anti-gun Democrats, it's safe to say the pro-gun grassroots is in for a massive political fight.

**[That is why I am asking all of my pro-gun friends to dig deep and make their most generous donation of $50, $30 or $10 to NAGR today](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zaehdq9c4d77ld8bfe5q1dhpp6qru96crnb9u6no_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ge9o72cjh2bs)**.

Fellow Patriot, I understand that the Biden economy is taking its toll on the American people and family budgets are already stretched incredibly thin.

But if HR 7910 and HR 2377 become law, the Second Amendment as we know it will never be the same.

If passed HR 7910, would do the following: *** Strip the 2A rights of military age adults under 21. *** Ban standard capacity magazines, rendering the law abiding dangerously out gunned by criminals. *** Implement a so-called "Safe Storage" law AKA home invader head start legislation. *** And a litany of other unconstitutional bans and restrictions on YOUR gun rights. And don't forget about _HR 2377, the due-process shredding "Red Flag" Gun Confiscation bill that also passed_.

**[For the sake of the U.S Constitution, please consider your most generous contribution to help your National Association for Gun Rights replenish our war chest and defeat Biden and the gun grabbers today](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb3fd2uc5e81su8kidj06fp5db8q6c1np0rm0dh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ge9o72cjh2bs)**.

And stay vigilant, Fellow Patriot, we have a massive political fight ahead of us, and we need every pro-gun American to keep the pressure on the politicians.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President
National Association for Gun Rights**

As soon as Monday, the Supreme Court will rule on the future of Roe v. Wade.
#
We need to be clear-eyed about the challenges that are on the horizon.
As soon as Monday, the Supreme Court will release its ruling in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_ — the case that will determine the future of _Roe v. Wade_.
Last month, a leaked draft opinion showed the Supreme Court had voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. If this ruling becomes official, Greg Abbott’s blanket ban on abortions will go into effect in Texas.
**We're not saying this to cause panic, but the truth is that we must prepare for this decision and plan our response.** The Supreme Court is readying to dismantle abortion rights and Congress won't save us, so it's up to all of us. If we want to protect a woman's right to choose, then we must elect Beto as the next Governor of Texas.
**[If we work together and turn our despair into action, we will win on November 8 and elect a pro-choice Governor for the state of Texas. Please, will you make a donation now to help elect Beto and defeat Greg Abbott?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220610-1.0zxa4L&refcode=ema20220610-193304&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=193304%2E444211%2E_A2r_2)**

  To: All Supporters

From: Coach Tuberville

June 9, 2022

Subject: Fighting to SAVE Clean & Safe Nuclear Power
Peter,

Our nation pioneered thorium molten salt breeder
reactor technologies, back in the 1960s. The promise of producing clean
and safe nuclear power was in our hands.

The Cold War – and the need
to build up our nuclear arsenal – led to the decades-long shelving of
thorium and Uranium 233 (U-233).

In 2001, the U.S. Department of
Energy began destroying our stocks of U-233.

Under the Obama
administration, we transferred our thorium technology to China.

And
now, the Chinese Communist Party is investing in it and preparing to
build thorium-powered aircraft carriers and reactors!

This is
insanity. We cannot leave the future of innovative clean energy
technologies in the hands of China.

As a member of the Senate Armed
Services Committee, I’m taking action to secure our energy future and
our national security. I’ve authored legislation – the Thorium Energy
Security Act – to stop the destruction of our nation’s U-233 stocks.
Now, I need your help to raise awareness on this critical issue and
rally the American people to DEMAND ACTION in Congress.

The promise of producing clean and safe nuclear power was in our hands. The Cold War – and the need to build up our nuclear arsenal – led to the decades-long shelving of thorium and Uranium 233 (U-233). In 2001, the U.S. Department of Energy began destroying our stocks of U-233. Under the Obama administration, we transferred our thorium technology to China. And now, the Chinese Communist Party is investing in it and preparing to build thorium-powered aircraft carriers and reactors! This is insanity. We cannot leave the future of innovative clean energy technologies in the hands of China. As a member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, I’m taking action to secure our energy future and our national security. Hello,
If you tuned into Fox ‘Entertainment’ News last night instead of any other channel, you would have seen an alternate universe, an upside down reality.
You wouldn’t have heard anything about Republican congressmen begging Trump for pardons after January 6th.

Dear Friend, .
When I started my campaign for Congress a year and a half ago, I did it because I could not stand by another day, another hour, watching this great country that I love disintegrate.
My team and I have been working tirelessly, traveling an insane amount of hours up and down the district, learning about the community's needs, and sharing my vision for the Great American Restoration.
And it is paying off! People are resonating with my message, and there is nowhere in the 4th district that you can go without seeing one of my signs.
But we still have a hard road to plow. As you may know, Washington State has a jungle primary, which means that all candidates, regardless of party affiliation, run in the same primary election. The top 2, again, regardless of party affiliation, make it to the general.
Since there is only one Democrat in the race, he will naturally take all the Democrat votes in the district. The rest of the votes will be split between 7 Republican candidates, which makes it extremely hard to beat the incumbent Dan Newhouse, who has the most name recognition. Many people do not pay a lot of attention to politics and will just vote for whoever they are familiar with.
---
---
A new data survey shows that I am the only Republican candidate that has a chance of beating Dan Newhouse in the primaries. The Democrat, Doug White, will almost definitely make it to the general election. If Dan Newhouse is the 2nd candidate to win the primary, it is possible that enough Republicans will stay home in the general election for Doug White to actually win the 4th district election. This would be the first time a Democrat has won the Congressional election since Jay Inslee won our district in 1993!
That would be a disaster.
It is important that our party unify around one candidate who has the ability and the infrastructure to beat Dan Newhouse.
I'm asking for your support to get out the vote for me. We do not want this district to end up with either a RINO or a Democrat in Congress at this most crucial time in our history.

Every $5 or $10 donation helps enormously, and I am grateful for each one. ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011hMShRt4hjyuLHwig2Z-AcCVfJm7yvT73U-u6By9kXKvQ09WHcnD7bU1oarTpWss_F1z3K2wy8DViAfKPgMGO0rZKW2ZbgCLM1OBdCbc8tFjpDFvqAmcLOrgq0o5xnycZ6yMxxhT3vG1bZLV2RxK-KGRHxJhgSwkN3J4mwoZk7n4rBCD3HqPld0ydmFuZje_&c=Z_F4ynBqI3RsRN9Aw2zwCMcKBViOD8mD1L19gI5R9S8teZnTnwFukw==&ch=9FAsaa4tpI_XuiqVyZ_taN2wML2_ORCNQUvxdnzwcI0P3GXF7KyUDg==)

God bless, Jerrod

body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pum
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z78iu7ghl87kre6t9vpat5hpdkorpkm4c6t8g978_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onl6cp74ojncopb8ojm68ojaslimhoj6crimep38t3l6krjcdhhcsrr0p32elo6fduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdn6mq60tr3coq61cr4cuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieco32c3h2bs)

---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.
---
| | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zp29j9f7e4brhrrh7clj3b3dmkffjf4jee3ktoug_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieco32c3h2bs)
---
[**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5688bt2kcmkmkdsv4i3pmjrng0m1i3ihlhi1ot8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieco32c3h2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5maqim286s2ol22m4lnhcrhj5jfi8ur12g84p78_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieco32c3h2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development
---
| | The Heritage Foundation 214 Massachusetts Avenue NE Washington D.C. 20002
---

name: Great America Update
subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6048%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=ZkkJBklI7xNDwHC5to4a6g&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62341%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VQq9RMPMINIv%2bi6cnDIBzQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62342%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zmpCqPhxEM6GdzFRAQaaUg&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62343%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=W5Bva8Gp6JxypbJbfYeMag&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

subject: I need to tell you something about my husband, Ben
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
If you know Ben, you’ll know he’s not afraid to stand up for what’s right. | | | |
---
|
---
| | | **“Someone profits from every problem we face; from Big Pharma to the gun manufacturers who fund the NRA. We can't let our democracy be just another investment opportunity awarded to the highest bidder.”
-Ben Smilowitz, Baltimore Sun, May 18, 2022**

**Dear Peter,**

The quote above is from a recent [“voter guide” in the Baltimore Sun](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=3dfa497454&e=0faa9de128). I wanted to share it with you because it says something important about my husband Ben, and what he stands for: **Ben fights for people, not whoever writes the biggest check.** That’s why he has focused on accountability in disaster relief for the last 15 years.

Ben has devoted his career to ensuring our leaders are held accountable, especially when the well-being of people is at stake. On guns, healthcare, the environment and reproductive choice, I think it’s fair to say our “leaders” have let us down.

**[Please donate, if you can, if you believe we need leaders who aren’t afraid to actually tackle our greatest challenges.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=8ae6a5a637&e=0faa9de128)**

If you know Ben, you’ll know he’s not afraid to stand up for what’s right. In order to win this primary to represent MD-6, his campaign needs your support.

I love Ben and have for a long time, but I believe this campaign is about more than my husband. It’s about who we are, and who we want to be.

[So please, get involved however you can. Thank you for listening. It means a lot to me that you’re supporting Ben. ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=ff58438c92&e=0faa9de128)

Sincerely,

Dr. Holly Zanville

**\- INDEMS Statement on Eric Holcomb and Indiana GOP’s Tax Refund - ** _“It’s encouraging to see Governor Holcomb and Indiana Republicans finally realize that there are ways the state government can combat global inflation. That said, it shouldn’t have taken this long to get the Republicans to actually act and produce what looks like another bare-minimum band-aid for Indiana’s long-term problems._ _Indiana Democrats had the foresight and called on the state to pause its gas tax back to help Hoosiers make ends meet. This win-win solution only adds to the Democrats’ plan to address rising costs across the state. But unfortunately, the Indiana GOP proves (again) they have no plans for our future - just election-year performance and partisanship.” -**said Lauren Ganapini, Executive Director of the Indiana Democratic Party**_

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. name: Greg Stamps
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsbq5b6hN5

Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have
provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions,
of political and...
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osbq5b6hN5

Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Greg
Stamps | Online Development
Hoover
Institution | Stanford University

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Jimmy Spinellamedia@brycereeves.com **Bryce Reeves Leads the Republican Field in Fundraising** **FREDERICKSBURG, VA – June 10, 2022 –** Following last night's filing report, Bryce Reeves is the clear fundraising leader in the Republican Primary for the 7th Congressional District. With a nearly $75,000 lead over his closest opponent, Bryce Reeves has displayed he will have the most resources to expend in the highly important race against Congresswoman Spanberger for control of the House of Representatives. After seeing the finance reports Bryce Reeves' campaign manager, Jimmy Spinella, said, “There is no surprise in seeing the fundraising match the polling. We are so grateful and thankful for all of our supporters. They understand that there are two people running for Congress in the 7th Congressional District, Bryce Reeves and Abigail Spanberger. It's time for us to unite as a party, and focus on our goal of winning this November." Senator Reeves' campaign has received an outpouring of support at all levels including the endorsements from sheriffs and conservative legislators across the district, former Governors George Allen and Bob McDonnell, U.S. Senators Mike Lee (R-Utah) and Marco Rubio (R-Florida), Trump Administration officials including ICE Director Tom Homan and Secretary of Energy Rick Perry.

| Transcript:“I don’t mean to trigger any woke liberals out there, but if you step onto my field talking politically correct nonsense, you probably won’t succeed. But Biden and the left celebrate when men win at women’s sports, and when we divide people by race. I fought for parental rights and I took on the liberals in Richmond. And I know as a coach, the best defense is a good offense. I’m ready to lead, fight, and win. I’m Bryce Reeves, and I approve this message."
---
| ###Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff's deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

body:
Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-a
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zooh0mbjq56u4plm9ol6q2hanfsp1cgvi8ik108g_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tbmmap3edr765qn8tjn6aq3cc71e8qe9p77mjjrcothc1gb4cdgm9hb0p5hmqoefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33dplmhg7epb66pib6o77m2qmash5u)
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi1m4jjg4fiuiq6nj2qeiq3ada9bopqr3k69tm48_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z11jm2g85gi21nfovpf8lunnf7dqkrku87lo96ro_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhlo22b3kbvj4hl0g0j3g03ma61mgso558892m1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zaqvobscbr4rr8qdb2u3iml3hs8vone4l0aidetg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm0itkbj1mipa2v7qr840162olie34791d6befn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6qvvf8blns0q8u784bfr0ncrjj3nkfumtk87v28_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zalu4l14g9v1kmg863n9taappksfdl0h32r9a938_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8ki9bbm6nbulocklkkib68v8e6ndeja86iblivo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl7bfohriclnilfg7nrj0te5a7bs0oahhu7sh910_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6ctfaj1vrjd800c95oubv2pa5agug45a0opelo0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z40ahnim2uuti00411kuvpfe258gm2l1scq8veq0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c3ieao74chh2bs)

A new report from The Washington Post reveals the true motivations behind the efforts by Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams to have the federal government cancel student loan debt: | "Georgia Democratic gubernatorial candidate Stacey Abrams and Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-Ga.) are pushing the Biden administration to cancel millions of dollars in federal student loan debt to boost their electoral prospects this fall, a Washington Post columnist alleged this week." Our opponent and the would-be governor of Georgia are apparently the two biggest supporters of student debt cancellation. They think that if President Biden and Democrats in Washington cancel the debt of enough young voters, they'll turn out to support Democrats in November's midterms. It's a crass political calculation at the expense of American taxpayers, and it's shameful. This is a prime example of politicians working to empower themselves rather than doing what's in the best interest of the people they're elected to represent. I'm running for the Senate because our opponent isn't doing enough to get the country back on track. If the allegations are true that Raphael Warnock is attempting to convince the president to take this action on student loan debt so he can beat me in November, then he should be totally ashamed. Our campaign isn't using taxpayer money to buy votes. While our opponent is busy whispering in the president's ear, I'm barnstorming the state of Georgia to find every vote I can to earn votes - the hard way. [](https://dancrenshaw.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c7ea7a5fdbae179f99b775342&id=aa5f95da29&e=2a9a0e6144) Dan Crenshaw served as a Navy SEAL for a decade, achieving the rank of Lieutenant Commander, and earned two Bronze Star Medals, one with Valor, the Purple Heart, and the Navy Commendation Medal with Valor. After being wounded in Afghanistan in 2012, he lost his right eye and required surgery to save the vision in his left. Retiring from the military in 2016, Crenshaw earned a Master of Public Administration from Harvard University's Kennedy School of Government in 2017. He was elected to the United States House of Representatives in November 2018, where he represents the Second Congressional District of Texas. He lives with his wife, Tara, and two dogs, Joey and Luna, in Houston.

Gas and diesel prices, which hit record highs almost daily, are key drivers of the dramatic increase in the cost of everyday living. At the same time, Rep. Liz Cheney, Wyoming’s lone member of Congress, is doing nothing to fight for the people who are suffering, instead playing a central role in the illegitimate January 6th Committee designed to distract people from the miserable record of President Biden.
Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today issued the following statement:
“The calamity that is the Biden administration keeps getting worse and working people in Wyoming and elsewhere are feeling it the most. Inflation has driven up the cost of nearly everything, while people are struggling to be able to fill their gas tanks to get to work and take care of their families. The front-page story in today’s Casper newspaper is about the devastating effect on our state energy industries, which are huge employers and economic drivers. Meanwhile, record-high diesel prices increase the cost of everything that needs to be shipped to market, and farmers are finding it to be outrageously expensive to continue to grow and transport the food we all need to survive. This is the time when Wyoming’s only member of Congress should be screaming from the rooftops that Joe Biden is crushing the American dream.
“Unfortunately, Liz Cheney is spending all her time auditioning for a CNN contract, taking center stage as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked tool on the January 6th Commission. Cheney is being used to impart phony bipartisanship to an illegitimate committee that violates even the House of Representatives’ own rules. Cheney has turned her back on Wyoming, but is using our only House seat to elevate and continue her own personal war on President Trump. She should be using all her strength to fight against the outrageously harmful Biden administration, but that would get in the way of her Trump obsession. When I am the next congresswoman from Wyoming, I will always remember who hired me and always represent Wyoming values.”

Gas and diesel prices, which hit record highs almost daily, are key drivers of the dramatic increase in the cost of everyday living. At the same time, Rep. Liz Cheney, Wyoming’s lone member of Congress, is doing nothing to fight for the people who are suffering, instead playing a central role in the illegitimate January 6th Committee designed to distract people from the miserable record of President Biden. Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today issued the following statement: “The calamity that is the Biden administration keeps getting worse and working people in Wyoming and elsewhere are feeling it the most. Inflation has driven up the cost of nearly everything, while people are struggling to be able to fill their gas tanks to get to work and take care of their families. The front-page story in today’s Casper newspaper is about the devastating effect on our state energy industries, which are huge employers and economic drivers. Meanwhile, record-high diesel prices increase the cost of everything that needs to be shipped to market, and farmers are finding it to be outrageously expensive to continue to grow and transport the food we all need to survive. This is the time when Wyoming’s only member of Congress should be screaming from the rooftops that Joe Biden is crushing the American dream. “Unfortunately, Liz Cheney is spending all her time auditioning for a CNN contract, taking center stage as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked tool on the January 6th Commission. Cheney is being used to impart phony bipartisanship to an illegitimate committee that violates even the House of Representatives’ own rules. Cheney has turned her back on Wyoming, but is using our only House seat to elevate and continue her own personal war on President Trump. She should be using all her strength to fight against the outrageously harmful Biden administration, but that would get in the way of her Trump obsession. Dear Friend,

There is simply too much on the line right now. We must stand together to find solutions to gun violence and hold elected officials accountable for not passing gun laws that protect us.

Tomorrow, Saturday June 11, attend one of the 300+ March for Our Lives [https://marchforourlives.com/] marches around the nation to do just that. March for Our Lives is policy-based and community-rooted and working to fight underlying forces that fuel gun violence.

Find a march near you. [https://secure.everyaction.com/p/4X6lOpXbV0e3Ba9SGz3dvw2]

We cannot wait for change to happen. We have to rise up NOW and show our lawmakers we need action on this issue.

Please join the movement tomorrow! [https://secure.everyaction.com/p/4X6lOpXbV0e3Ba9SGz3dvw2]

name: Peter Welch
subject: What we’re hearing from the January 6th Commission
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Democracy is on the line—and we have to do everything we can to protect it.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=521%2E61531%2ESdlEH_)
Hello,
It's been easy to take democracy for granted in America, but it’s imperiled, and it demands our attention.
The House January 6th Commission started to reveal their findings last night, and it’s worse than we even imagined. The horrifying details about the insurrection are breathtaking, and a haunting reminder how close we were to losing our democracy.
I’m going to keep working to make sure we get all the facts on this attempt to overturn an election—from the plot to incite a violent attack on our country to the ongoing efforts by Trump Republicans to take a hammer to our democracy by denying the will of the voters.
Driven by Trump and his Big Lie, Republican elected officials are taking steps through making it harder to vote, gerrymandering congressional districts so politicians pick their voters not the other way around, and taking away the independent role of state authorities to certify election results in order to destabilize free and fair elections in the future.
**The right to vote and the peaceful transfer of power are core tenets of our nation’s democracy. And our future depends on our ability to protect and strengthen our democracy.**
Each of us has a role to play to help keep our democracy alive, and I’ve seen it throughout our Vermont communities—Vermonters working together in ways both big and small to rebuild trust and protect our democracy. From registering neighbors to vote, to casting ballots in every local election, to educating friends and family about legislation that can make a difference, and more. And I’m ready to bring this Vermont Way to the Senate on Day One.
Fighting for our democracy is one of the core reasons I’m in this race. Remember, the same Republicans who voted to overturn the election could be in control of Congress next year if we lose key races like this one. [**If you think protecting our democracy is one of the most important issues we face in this election, I’d appreciate it if you signed your name alongside other grassroots supporters.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-democracy/?source=em_20220610_p_p_democracy&t=3&akid=521%2E61531%2ESdlEH_)
Democracy is on the ballot in November, and we can't let it lose.
Thanks for being with me in this fight.
Peter

We weren’t able to hire a team of door knockers to help us spread our campaign literature a couple of weeks ago because we didn’t raise enough money to cover their costs. Would you consider helping us find the funds to hire a team to knock doors this weekend? **[We need $4,000 to hire a team of ten folks for two days.](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=18040838077244c9b1047248c1f46025&_e=4GSSPbpUGW33aOLNiks1SJFVu7K9UAUntd-S3CVCqMNq07Wk0OFdHIeGirt3mg4dZmNinZCrBl1nK35wQrHC3UW5xCYA6dYCGkNzFzt21ldPTOjD55F6cuduWfNc0lFFRkl1-wP3rPeZ3d_2OIv9dcPVWhoK9xeeRcFXPI2otYL__itFDDgyKNX6Cogh3aRVuMaJuuamBJtoUWxMEL2WBOiKhUnRhHPTSB-RtCC4I3TgclKmhUNP83r1A2k7dBZwd_XN315OzHe8Lkmc18_XxxVh8B0Q6qcNP2c7kxMnfCr6ohBeV-ngZEt7ywpo_IOcZoTrfXBvFfzqyP1juINzBbbzRKZEeB37lZRmPuTIXDIVa5FnNSKfRQDterwbd832nLrHkB__c7GemXNKUZRlJaKk441YTItm0AAmPg11dFAHmBr6NdF213pokGabRo5hfYDs7m8C8lXkFajZF9a6tQ%3D%3D)**

**At 17,181 square miles, our district is just too big for the three people I have on staff to do all by ourselves.**

[** CHIP IN $4 TO SPONSOR A DOOR KNOCKER ➞ **](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=18040838077244c9b1047248c1f46025&_e=4GSSPbpUGW33aOLNiks1SJFVu7K9UAUntd-S3CVCqMNq07Wk0OFdHIeGirt3mg4dZmNinZCrBl1nK35wQrHC3UW5xCYA6dYCGkNzFzt21ldPTOjD55F6cuduWfNc0lFFRkl1-wP3rPeZ3d_2OIv9dcPVWhoK9xeeRcFXPI2otYL__itFDDgyKNX6Cogh3aRVuMaJuuamBJtoUWxMEL2WBOiKhUnRhHPTSB-RtCC4I3Qafsj2cbVGwiG7aHDl0hXW-V9zhFgArETjvwg_5qDMAbICN835nCQ8oPY9Ul69r7qYJQnK0jTXlP2if8x5eaUHRLEpz2qZy2Xgg0F04az8JUgPqUoyAu-TgY-QK-9YQqcWIwC22Z0OD5fbeTmv9WfO5NIQMAb-X5MqtcJjf-rPH52rZeLmwlUL3a5nZsTkdLf-fUj12xNWuHv3RZHqt77VCQKDhaKH25EDsVTTisI6BkZoCJZi2Y2fzMIpjbTzH0c%3D)

Peter,

There is a very good chance that you’ve been visited by a political candidate and you may not have 1.) answered the door or 2.) been home. But in politics, **knocking doors as it’s known is one of the best ways that we can reach the voters who have the power to propel us into office or send us a message that they’re just not buying what we’re offering**.

Just before the Memorial Day holiday I sent out an email to you all letting you know that we wouldn’t be taking the extended holiday weekend for leisure, but rather we’d be working. You see, **we have a very large district which means a lot of territory to cover**. Me and my core team can’t hit every house we need to just by ourselves. **[That’s why we asked for your help to raise funds so we could pay a professional door knocking team to help us get the job done.](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=18040838077244c9b1047248c1f46025&_e=4GSSPbpUGW33aOLNiks1SJFVu7K9UAUntd-S3CVCqMNq07Wk0OFdHIeGirt3mg4dZmNinZCrBl1nK35wQrHC3UW5xCYA6dYCGkNzFzt21ldPTOjD55F6cuduWfNc0lFFRkl1-wP3rPeZ3d_2OIv9dcPVWhoK9xeeRcFXPI2otYL__itFDDgyKNX6Cogh3aRVuMaJuuamBJtoUWxMEL2WBOiKhUnRhHPTSB-RtCC4I3TgclKmhUNP83r1A2k7dBZwCrmzIheDOYIYEJig4tUTjVaAET_kBSDS-Mf2hRpIr1aNNixwA-_iUo8GfkggGdYjF_M-3xK5JFVaLqz9rOXt0kjCT5xHWHBONt34mjmGRezXDyWfzX5679QkaTTc2G6j2ySgfOHuDycSE3H-Hc531O_rSEmT5VxJi8u1WpLBD1PYsu9yDM8qAWtq5ZR3rESYlIqQnY5VVyO3l2PR3w8fYw%3D%3D) **

My guess is that most of you weren’t checking email that weekend because **we only raised $1,668**. Not enough to pay a team of 10 professionals to spend two days helping us make contact with folks.

SO, we’re trying this one more time in the hopes that our second attempt might yield better results.

Hey fellow patriot,

name: Charles Booker
subject: We haven’t forgotten Rand
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Last night, the House select committee held its first hearing regarding
their investigation of the January 6 insurrection at the U.S. Capitol.

It’s more evident than ever that Trump and his allies like Rand Paul are
responsible for the violence and carnage of January 6. It was fueled by
hate and racism, lies of a “stolen” election, and a desperate grab for
power. Countless first responders were critically injured. Six people
died.

We refuse to forget the sacrifice of our first responders. We refuse to
forget this attack on our democracy. We must continue calling for justice
until every person, every elected official involved in the attack is held
accountable.

You know who wishes we’d forget? Rand Paul. He’s tried countless times to
gaslight us into thinking it was just a “tourist visit”. Rand voted to
block a full investigation into what happened.

Because he was complicit. For months leading up to the attack, Rand Paul
stoked his base, promoting false narratives of “stolen votes” and fraud –
a claim that members of his own party have even walked back.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220610.43vdGD&refcode=em20220610-2047&t=1001&akid=2047%2E346206%2ED-Igns ][IMG]

It’s shameful — but it is nothing new,
Peter. For years, Rand Paul has
been working to suppress our votes to keep his own seat.

Kentucky has one of the worst records of voter disenfranchisement in our
country’s history. For too long, massive groups of people, especially
Black and brown communities, have been excluded and discouraged from
voting. As a result, the number of people in Kentucky who don’t vote
outnumber those who do.

We know that a different type of politics is possible — and that’s what
our movement is fighting for. Together, we have the power to replace Rand
Paul and every politician who betrayed our democracy last January.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220610.43vdGD&refcode=em20220610-2047&t=1002&akid=2047%2E346206%2ED-Igns ]If you’re ready to join me in this work, will you chip
in $5 or anything you can today to our people-powered
campaign? We must send a loud and clear message today to Rand Paul that
this movement remembers and that we are rising up to hold him accountable
at the ballot box on Election Day.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220610.43vdGD&refcode=em20220610-2047&t=1021&akid=2047%2E346206%2ED-Igns ]Contribute $5

Together we can save our Democracy,

Charles Booker

* A major life change: "I am 57 and do not have any retirement monies (or even savings), so I can never retire with the loans. I could help my children pay for college. I could help my husband pay the mortgage."

body:
I believe it is up to us, the American people, to ensure the events of January 6th are not forgotten and never repeated.

| Peter,

I was in the House gallery on January 6th, 2021, when a mob of right-wing domestic terrorists stormed the United States Capitol in a Donald Trump-inspired attempt to overturn the results of our free and fair election. I crouched below the balcony walls alongside Rep. Jason Crow (D-CO) as we hid from the rioters; I made what I thought could be my final call to my children.

Last night, the committee investigating January 6 held its first public hearing, revealing substantial evidence that _former President Trump and his allies engaged in a criminal conspiracy to defraud the American public, and that Trump violated multiple laws in his attempt to overturn the results of the presidential election._

I believe it is up to us, the American people, **to ensure the events of January 6th are not forgotten and never repeated.**

I will never stop fighting to defend the integrity of our democracy. With Republicans pulling out all the stops to get me out of Congress this November and replace me with a rubber stamp for their far-right agenda, we need all hands on deck. name: Christopher Kurka
subject: Bloated Budgets, Abortion Funding, and PFD Vetoes - Oh My!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687
body:
Why I voted no on the biggest budget in Alaska's history.

| Dear Peter,
I acknowledge many of you are angry. Given what Alaskans have suffered during the last six years of government mismanagement, who can blame you? **I certainly don’t.** My frustration and disappointment during the last two legislative sessions has been great. Opportunity after opportunity was put forward to fund a full PFD – and time and time again the majority of Alaska’s legislators decided to put their own special interests ahead of the people of Alaska. **Each time I had the chance to vote for a stand-alone full-PFD, backpay on our stolen****PFDs, or interest on that backpay, I did so gladly and proudly, even sponsoring some of the****amendments that would have provided this restitution.**
Two short years ago, I made the difficult decision to put my life on hold and filed to run for legislative office. This choice came out of a profound sense of frustration and anger with the political status quo. I was tired of politicians telling me one thing during campaign season but doing precisely the opposite once elected. Fed up with the excuses, I ran for office to reverse the damage done by those politicians, who with predictable and disturbing regularity, refused to stand and fight for the values you and I hold dear.
When I ran for office, I promised to be the fighter all those politicians refused to be. **I told you****the root of the government’s problem was wanton spending and criticized my opponent for****voting for the largest budgets in State history.**
**I promised to be a staunch opponent of Big Government** , and to do what was necessary to address the problem. **I promised to take on the out-of-control State spending** that was and is stifling our economy, killing our jobs, driving us into deep deficits, and let’s not forget, robbing us of our PFDs. **I promised to stand up for the weakest and most vulnerable among us, namely babies in the womb, by fighting to end public funding for abortion** (an issue that polling says nearly two-thirds of the country supports). And **I promised to fight for a full statutory PFD with backpay.**
In keeping with those promises, I made the decision to vote against the **record-breaking $14.5****Billion** (PFD excluded) **abortion-funding state budget.** This vote was in line with my campaign promises and kept me from joining the ranks of an all too familiar club of political liars and charlatans.
Because of the very public nature of the budget concurrence vote and some false premises that have been circulating about what the vote meant, I wanted to give you my reasons in detail for my “No” vote:
**1\. The 2023 Senate budget bill was the biggest in State history:** precisely the kind of bill I identified to my constituents as the problem with State Government, and I stand by that. It was for this reason that I voted against the House version of the budget, before the Senate sent back their even-larger version for a concurrence vote. **Clearly, it is****voting for these kinds of budgets which will ensure final destruction of the PFD.** Does this mean I’m opposed to a full statutory dividend? **Absolutely not!!!**
In keeping with my promises, during my two budget cycles in office, **I have fought tirelessly for a full statutory dividend, voting 32 times for a full statutory PFD, restitution for stolen PFDs, and even back interest on those PFDs, which were clearly taken from Alaskans unlawfully.** I remain resolved not to contribute to the problem, and as such I will not participate in political games. I will not be bribed. I will not be bought. I will not be intimidated. And I will never be a voluntary hostage of the Big Government Cabal. **During my time as District 7 Representative, full statutory funding of the PFD with restitution has been my number one “spending priority.”** My “no” vote on budget concurrence was not in opposition to this priority, but rather in fulfillment of other campaign promises to vote against bloated and oversized budgets and to be a defender of the unborn.
**Note:** in my opinion, the PFD distribution should not be an appropriation in the state budgeting process, but simply funded according to the existing statutory formula. It has only been done this way in recent years because of a bad court decision after then- Governor Walker stole Alaskans’ PFD through the veto process. My interpretation of the Constitution is that the PFD is outside of the appropriation process and should not be included in our budget deliberations - _this years’ budget concurrence vote is a great example of why not._ **2\. The 2023 Senate budget bill provided funding for abortion:** It is unconscionable that Senate Republicans in the Finance Committee stripped budget language barring state- sponsored abortion funding \- pro-life language which ironically was approved by the Democrat controlled State House. Senate Republican leadership, joined by “Republican” Senator Josh Revak, then rejected an attempt to amend the bill and restore the Pro-life language before the bill’s final reading.
I subsequently made a public pledge to Governor Dunleavy that **I would vote for concurrence if he would provide assurance to honor the intent language already in the budget and end abortion payments.** However, _the Governor ignored my repeated calls and requests for a meeting_ , choosing rather to negotiate with moderate Republicans and pro-abortion Democrats behind closed doors, most of whom consistently voted against the full statutory PFD earlier in the session.
**It is no secret that I consider The Right to Life to be our first Liberty** , that upon which all other rights and freedoms depend and find their definition. I will not now, nor will I ever, apologize for prioritizing human life before all other issues. **3\. The promise of a $5,500 PFD was always destined to be a “bait and switch.”** This became clear shortly after reports began circulating of the Governor’s likely veto of at least $1,300 of the purported $5,500 total PFD being sold to Alaskans. This was a result of secret negotiations that the Governor was having with both moderate Republicans and Leftist Democrats.
The bottom line is this: **Alaskans were never going to get a $5,500 PFD** , regardless of whether the budget concurrence vote was successful or not. The Governor had already made that obvious by the unrefuted claims that had been leaked to the media: the $1,300 “energy relief check” (PFD backpay) was just not going to happen. _By the time the vote took place, it was not clear how much additional PFD the Governor had agreed to veto in order to allow Moderate Republicans political cover in voting for a “full PFD”._ **I can only assume that these secret negotiations included a veto agreement of the PFD down to the Governor’s proposed 50/50 plan that he had presented in his budget to the legislature earlier this year.** This would have resulted in a PFD that was well below the statutory amount.
**4\. The 2023 Senate budget bill was a raw deal for Alaska’s future.** Imagine a precedent
where politicians are required to vote for literally _anything_ , so long as there’s a PFD attached. That is the future many are clamoring for. **The Big Government and Special Interest Cabals are watching and taking notes.** Don’t think they won’t try this again, and again, and again. Do you really want to send the message to future legislators that they must check their principles at the door if they wish to serve? If so, it is unrealistic to expect budget accountability, a place for conscience, restraints on government, and a place for the people’s voice in the process.
If you want real change, it is imperative we have principled statesmen, men and women who won’t be bought, bribed, or coerced. This is the only hope for our state’s future. **It is going to take men and women of courage, character, and conviction to effect real change.**
You and I both know the current trajectory is unsustainable and will end in disaster. Hopefully, we all want the law to be followed and the people’s resources to be given back to their rightful owners. **My position on paying a full PFD, and back-PFDs with interest hasn’t changed,** _but I cannot, and we should not, accept a one-time payment at the price of all that we hold dear._ We must fight Big Government together, rein in State spending, reduce regulation, and create a free and competitive economy for our great state.
I know you’re a resilient and smart Alaskan who cares about the future of our State as much as I do. I’m asking you to resist the temptation to buy the spin of those telling you that “you just don’t understand.” **You and I both know what the score is**. Alaska’s lawmakers are not “smarter” than you – they just have bigger egos. I trust that you can look at the current situation and see it for what it is. **We know that selling the future for a paltry moment of instant gratification is not the right path.** Now is a critical time for us to unite and fight the Big Government and Special Interest Cabals. As we do so we can restore fiscal sanity, end abortion, permanently secure the statutory dividend, _and win this war for Alaska’s future._ But if we continue to allow those who “represent” us to compromise our principles, you can only expect more empty promises and diminishing returns. **For my part, I will never apologize to you for being too Conservative and for keeping my campaign promises and I’m certain you wouldn’t want me to!** May God bless you and may God bless the Great State of Alaska! Soli Deo Gloria, Christopher Kurka [](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzW-zEK-3Z9mAZxjdCeR3iqLWUT4kcfhLZxsXf_4rl-GR&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=budget_vote_op_ed&n=1) [www.ChrisKurka.com](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzZYHrXjSSqDZFm4adezdWWY&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=budget_vote_op_ed&n=2) Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687.

The Big Government and Special Interest Cabals are watching and taking notes. Don’t think they won’t try this again, and again, and again. Do you really want to send the message to future legislators that they must check their principles at the door if they wish to serve? If so, it is unrealistic to expect budget accountability, a place for conscience, restraints on government, and a place for the people’s voice in the process. If you want real change, it is imperative we have principled statesmen, men and women who won’t be bought, bribed, or coerced. This is the only hope for our state’s future. It is going to take men and women of courage, character, and conviction to effect real change. You and I both know the current trajectory is unsustainable and will end in disaster. Hopefully, we all want the law to be followed and the people’s resources to be given back to their rightful owners. My position on paying a full PFD, and back-PFDs with interest hasn’t changed, but I cannot, and we should not, accept a one-time payment at the price of all that we hold dear. We must fight Big Government together, rein in State spending, reduce regulation, and create a free and competitive economy for our great state. I know you’re a resilient and smart Alaskan who cares about the future of our State as much as I do. I’m asking you to resist the temptation to buy the spin of those telling you that “you just don’t understand.” You and I both know what the score is. Alaska’s lawmakers are not “smarter” than you – they just have bigger egos. I trust that you can look at the current situation and see it for what it is. We know that selling the future for a paltry moment of instant gratification is not the right path. Now is a critical time for us to unite and fight the Big Government and Special Interest Cabals. As we do so we can restore fiscal sanity, end abortion, permanently secure the statutory dividend, and win this war for Alaska’s future. But if we continue to allow those who “represent” us to compromise our principles, you can only expect more empty promises and diminishing returns. For my part, I will never apologize to you for being too Conservative and for keeping my campaign promises and I’m certain you wouldn’t want me to! May God bless you and may God bless the Great State of Alaska! Soli Deo Gloria, Christopher Kurka Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687. -=-=- Kurka for Governor · AK 99654, United States

This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Peter,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60562992:6j0BsFoNc:m:1:3253819041:C210F828EF0D686C9A675A1F2DD515CA:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60562992:6j0BsFoNc:m:1:3253819041:C210F828EF0D686C9A675A1F2DD515CA:r)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60562992:6j0BsFoNc:m:1:3253819041:C210F828EF0D686C9A675A1F2DD515CA:r)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60562992:6j0BsFoNc:m:1:3253819041:C210F828EF0D686C9A675A1F2DD515CA:r)

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60562992:6j0BsFoNc:m:1:3253819041:C210F828EF0D686C9A675A1F2DD515CA:r)

body:
| | | Hi team, We **MUST** do everything within our power to protect our children, ourselves and our neighbors from the epidemic of gun violence. Houstonians, along with Americans all across our country, want action that is focused on **_saving lives_** rather than on ideological principles. Studies and polls continue to show that a strong majority of Americans support common sense gun reforms such as universal background checks and “red flag” laws. Following the tragic shootings at Santa Fe High School in 2018, Mayor Turner appointed a Commission Against Gun Violence that included a wide range of stakeholders. They produced a comprehensive set of recommendations that included enacting common sense gun reforms, increasing mental health resources, and enhancing school security. As a member of City Council at that time, I stood in solidarity with Mayor Turner and the Commission in sending these recommendations to the Texas Legislature in early 2019. As your next Mayor, I will continue to be a committed voice for rational and comprehensive reforms to reduce the tragic toll of gun violence. With common sense gun policies and other measures, we can make our community and our residents much safer. And when the inevitable future event requires us to look parents and family members in the eye, we will each be called upon to account for our action or inaction at this moment. I invite you all to join me this Saturday at 10 am at City Hall in support of [**March For Our Lives Houston**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDAzWZtIWLvETQgiYf0JaadnX0QG-51PekCMvD5vQTpLxAvZILGqlMSSIEvMmm59TzMwHREwHoGuXPAYoyCQagh2vbU9ZzT6ldsFoUcCcQzbw4UaJovWWVKzGdbo-1JJmr94sltl30TgPEENyJr9lKTh7gn2GVjDFzBvOjkKZKjmLNuFPXXiUnEOSo1hv1WokiDc05INJudjQOQc77oikeTMWeogctd-IqYHfzpURE24zmunNTDQokY2UQ0-cUFhgjEXR_B1xz8uGm0QzHmjoH88bDqvfiWy2KYQ7OO0E_Iiq/3ms/G8Uc8zSSR0-CiJCvg7x3fQ/h0/WxWn6ym_ssEjXxQwoMsPgFkeISlNNr17hqHhyEi7vYE) to insist that the time for action is **NOW.** Thank you,

name: AOC Organizing Squad
subject: This Sunday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
NY Assembly elections are just weeks away (June 28th!) so the time to take action is now.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220610-3094-header&t=1&akid=3094%2E2526796%2EAbcJ-0)
Team AOC and New York City’s Democratic Socialists for America chapter are teaming up to knock doors and phone bank voters this SUNDAY to help elect our endorsed candidates for the New York State Assembly.
Assembly elections are less than 3 weeks away (June 28th!) so the time to take action is now. [**Will you join us for a phone bank this Sunday at 1pm ET/10am PT to call voters?**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14669?t=2&akid=3094%2E2526796%2EAbcJ-0)
The legislative session in Albany just ended and it was abundantly clear: we need more democratic socialist organizers in office. Right now, corporate-backed incumbents in the NY State Assembly are blocking guaranteed healthcare, affordable housing, and climate justice. Until we win a progressive State Assembly, none of our priority policies will pass.
Here are the details for the phone bank – you can join virtually from anywhere!
[AOC For The Many Phonebank](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14669?t=3&akid=3094%2E2526796%2EAbcJ-0)
Sunday, June 12
1:00pm ET/10am PT
Zoom
**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14669?t=4&akid=3094%2E2526796%2EAbcJ-0)**
---
After gathering together on Zoom, we will divide participants into breakout rooms for each candidate. If you prefer to phone bank for a particular candidate, you can let us know.
From the Hudson Valley to Brooklyn, these candidates running for the Assembly are committed to organizing the working class in their districts and increasing our collective power in order to take decisive action on the climate crisis, housing, and healthcare.
Here’s a bit more about some of the candidates:
* **Samy Olivares, AD 54** \- was raised by a single mother who relied on public programs to make ends meet. Samy has organized to end the school to prison pipeline and advocate for healthcare for all. Samy would be the first genderqueer state legislator in New York.
* **Vanessa Agudelo, AD 95** \- is the proud daughter of Colombian immigrants and lifelong Peekskill resident. Vanessa fought against the Spectra fracked gas pipeline expansion. As an immigrant rights organizer, she led the campaign to pass the first-in-the-nation Excluded Workers Fund.
* **Sarahana Shrestha, AD 103** \- was nine years old when she witnessed a historic uprising in Nepal. In the wake of the devastation, she remembers returning to villages to see how a single public road transformed the lives of entire communities. She continues to fight for public infrastructure today, leading the campaign for public renewables.

Thank you for stepping up to volunteer your time. It makes all the difference.
Hope to see you on Sunday,
AOC Organizing Squad
P.S. If you know someone in New York City, [**please invite them to join an in-person canvass with us this Sunday**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14668?t=5&akid=3094%2E2526796%2EAbcJ-0).
