Assembly elections are less than 3 weeks away (June 28th!) so the time to take action is now. The legislative session in Albany just ended and it was abundantly clear: we need more democratic socialist organizers in office. Right now, corporate-backed incumbents in the NY State Assembly are blocking guaranteed healthcare, affordable housing, and climate justice. Until we win a progressive State Assembly, none of our priority policies will pass. Here are the details for the phone bank – you can join virtually from anywhere! Sunday, June 12 1:00pm ET/10am PT Zoom After gathering together on Zoom, we will divide participants into breakout rooms for each candidate. If you prefer to phone bank for a particular candidate, you can let us know. From the Hudson Valley to Brooklyn, these candidates running for the Assembly are committed to organizing the working class in their districts and increasing our collective power in order to take decisive action on the climate crisis, housing, and healthcare. Here’s a bit more about some of the candidates: Samy Olivares, AD 54 \- was raised by a single mother who relied on public programs to make ends meet. Samy has organized to end the school to prison pipeline and advocate for healthcare for all. Samy would be the first genderqueer state legislator in New York. Vanessa Agudelo, AD 95 \- is the proud daughter of Colombian immigrants and lifelong Peekskill resident. Vanessa fought against the Spectra fracked gas pipeline expansion. As an immigrant rights organizer, she led the campaign to pass the first-in-the-nation Excluded Workers Fund. Sarahana Shrestha, AD 103 \- was nine years old when she witnessed a historic uprising in Nepal. In the wake of the devastation, she remembers returning to villages to see how a single public road transformed the lives of entire communities. She continues to fight for public infrastructure today, leading the campaign for public renewables. Thank you for stepping up to volunteer your time. It makes all the difference. Hope to see you on Sunday, AOC Organizing Squad P.S. If you know someone in New York City, . | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

Derek —

We just counted up the number of attacks on Adam that aired across Trump’s
favorite TV channels — Fox News, Newsmax and OANN in the last 24 hours. We
won’t even get into Twitter. Jeez Louise. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2022_abs_em.pEwDN5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220610_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=345%2E5257348%2EhbYJJ0 ]Before we get into it, can
you rush a donation to help us respond to the attacks that are already
coming in fast from the right-wing propaganda machine?

There have been dozens and dozens of them. From Fox News hosts. From
Trump’s ultra MAGA Republican Members of Congress. From Republican
gadflies. And more. Vicious attacks.

We wonder why. Do you think it has anything to do with Adam’s efforts to
hold Trump accountable?

Here’s just a taste from Fox News’ primetime host Jesse Waters:

“And then there is Shifty [Adam] Schiff. He has been trying to take down Trump
for years. He was the number one pusher of the Russia hoax. He intentionally
lied to the American people claiming that Trump colluded with the Kremlin, and
was Putin’s asset. Meanwhile, the whole time he knew that there was never any
evidence. He lied during the investigation. He lied during the impeachment
hearings...”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2022_abs_em.pEwDN5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220610_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=345%2E5257348%2EhbYJJ0 ]Jesse Waters spreading lies about Adam on Fox News

Every single statement this Fox News host made is a lie. And he knows it.
(Apparently, they think that giving Trump’s internal campaign polling day
and battleground plans to Russian intelligence while the Kremlin helped
their campaign was just good old-fashioned cheating with the enemy.)

Sean Hannity and Tucker Carlson got into it, too. We just won’t share
their particular brand of bile here.

Even Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy, who has repeatedly promised to
retaliate against Adam and kick him off his committees for holding Trump
accountable, attacked too:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jun2022_abs_em.pEwDN5&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220610_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=345%2E5257348%2EhbYJJ0 ]Kevin McCarthy holds a briefing and lies about Adam

“Just saying that name should be enough. But we watched what Shift (sic) has
done to our country. The years of lying about the Russian hoax. The changing of
evidence...”

Again, all lies. But we'd expect nothing less from Kevin.

We don’t need to tell you this, but these are all very desperate people.
Swinging wildly to distract and deflect, all while defending a
twice-impeached, dangerously unethical former president.

And McCarthy is not alone. Jim Jordan, Elise Stefanik, Marjorie Taylor
Greene and Matt Gaetz have all attacked Adam in the last few days.
Repeatedly.

But listen, although these attacks on Adam and his work are patently
false, they still take a real toll. And we need to respond.

# **Newsletter-Jun 10 Vol. 2, #16**
---
| | |
##
10 Jun 22

**Only 5 Weeks Until The July 19 Primary.**

One of the first acts of the first President (George Washington) of the first Congress was to hold Divine services.
Throughout our nation's history, those in office would make proclamations for days of Prayer and Fasting. This Saturday, June 11 is one of those days for the campaign. We need God's blessings, intervention and protection and you are invited to participate. There are no scheduled campaign activities this weekend.

The week of June 12th, the campaign will resume our normal rhythm. Door Hangers are distributed to targeted areas Tuesdays and Wednesdays, Meet & Greets on Thursdays and Team Door Hanger Distribution & Sign Waving on Saturdays. Texts and calls are made to voters throughout the week. Thousands and thousands of voters have been impacted. Thank You!

**Juneteenth Parade**
The campaign has been invited to the Juneteenth Parade on Saturday, June 18 in District Heights.
Line up by 10a.
The parade will depart from First Baptist Heights Church of District Heights
7234 Lansdale St., District Heights, 20747
We invite you to make this event and have strong & diverse participation from the campaign.
Please reply with your RSVP to participate.

**Meet & Greet**
Another Meet & Greet will be held Thursday, Jun 16.
7-8p
McDonalds
13800 Outlet Dr, Silver Spring, 20904
Briggs Chaney Market Place
Come and learn about our historic movement and meet Jeff.

**Sign Waving - One Power Hour**
There will be no sign waving Saturday, June 18 due to the parade.

**Phone Calling**
Phone Calling is a key strategy to impact voters and is very simple. Many of the voters have received a door hanger and met Jeff. The pre-recorded voicemail from Jeff is an important part of our strategy to reinforce our messaging that Jeff is "Standing With You And For You!"

You can make an impact no matter where you live in the nation. Please email the campaign at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com if you’re in interested in getting trained. It's easy.

**Social Media**
The campaign is taking steps to build Jeff Warner's social media presence.
You can find Jeff under RepJeffWarner on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/RepJeffWarner) & Twitter (@RepJeff Warner).
Be sure to like, share, subscribe, follow, etc. to help us grow his following.

Thank You for your support. The campaign continues to make and break records. Come and be a part of this amazing team. Imagine how good it will be to say you were part of this team in November as we celebrate our historic victory!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=a9f8095068&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Other liberal-run cities should take a page from San Francisco's book. Just look at the data from Baltimore, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York City, Philadelphia, Seattle, and Washington D.C. The [data shows](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=db0bc5b065c14bf4838b813077990e1e&_e=gt2L2C9-BURbZLj1J-ToQARMb9LxpWXSq3gjw3XxPT13Gju2nxJPbTK6laxsR4BRqZX0q8vcvx36rj9CqM9L9_zURpaLJqd154l6JQK4F12PIEEUcXAossWjwnnZA2QPd21D8CDXyeFXnXLChNC4QzNVJqtZeAGTE0Jcu2Wgv3tHz2A70XuyRDBdfPC2uNzpUP3bUw19LrpzxcvCHlf3Yit05Updeqyo-1fiyC39HkhQpV2Y7c4dQXs8ekyT3reedlTlT45vmVH6z82t5QbmJPr7lQF4mFvz_sxMuxBRq3GzXxFx2ecTWFpreK8vyfBgX2Znh_EsTOFIqzA7ntPMIA%3D%3D) violent crime increased from nearly 5% up to 40% compared to the same time frame in 2021. New York City is the worst off—recording 43,244 violent crime incidents since May 15, compared to 2021’s 30,754 recorded during the same time frame. And that doesn’t even account for the inevitable [summer crime surges](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=db0bc5b065c14bf4838b813077990e1e&_e=gt2L2C9-BURbZLj1J-ToQCXBvyxFfUfWEj_BFGLgDU_lFh85bWujxxLvWRbBFMgRhLigzFe6pcem0PtobA33EAqS-xf8hOIflz5j61F0yZ5bUzSAtHIMqXUuGCcStHP9ZMt5kzveopo5EDTp5TNVFgAp7Spoc-zz8-XDgHaUv0Hz8NjUyPIcKFObXHms6-6WO-SMCRfMC_wzfqbGBs2fLSvIqnft15Bd-pAmM66pTikGlcGpfpkMF8gn4fi51QStTs6X_crTWwopymvPt5KHxxWZ-YrVjf_XI7ta2qTyu7HGAiY3xpGblyjysCua-i1DGpuTwkuX3hD437ktsq73etA4_UZ0f4gxD-6mT4A3iDE%3D). This trend is heartbreaking, especially since it didn’t have to be this way. Bad policy choices led to the increase in crime—unnecessary [lockdowns](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=db0bc5b065c14bf4838b813077990e1e&_e=gt2L2C9-BURbZLj1J-ToQOBBtLY4G2VnGmicMyKWcxoCBvUPDLtj2BR5JYW1ne-nOiMtBKClUQ8RdGuiWFmloLC8cQawdiNWoWNo7bmQsJBIZ7eIkMxZCrLT6Jah6ySuegTkozcsr61fYRk-1lMGIAq-L7lZSPzaE_w41EycAOZTSOdkelrZ9V63edMe7jScGOhO4yvHqOQohJn5MBXolj9BqfwL5vr0B1NjlzVYo18Y3TcfQbrRvfe5pLXe76r81kCkWvsozhbWdOVDeQD43bXX8byjGJ-Yvtj_smf393XfXb5f4KpxH6HB-yvTTSYbSndLFMfhLBNkFkUvBwqiqIOB2dT3Rnaq2Hyxez4-HilgBMGpe7Fc_so2SAa2HkE7os4fvv9nEw71vzOG2rzqSw%3D%3D), attacks on law enforcement, the [defund](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=db0bc5b065c14bf4838b813077990e1e&_e=gt2L2C9-BURbZLj1J-ToQARMb9LxpWXSq3gjw3XxPT3Tij1O16JMdm9PxcipgFwUNPhlm1A-CqqhFEtul8xL5pd411OwNo0ARp4r_9UOnH47vj6FkCVKrapfdQPvgFKzr2x_Q-n3atOG2vIUP-IuHFhWTZjPCrqvLM6J22qlnBl8ckKmN2ViCdHS_hNtV3uJ1qYFyqgToqj5nGFKLICqT0fLP6cO07tcVqlpQzLhFDxNzXTwIt3kXCWzXIsFoNRPU4yf7SW32-r2Kn4Dab52An8kRJ8DSxA_KbWvCMWTZVWzTcK70-yFqovCw8RJBvzE5qgkZVvgn4JU8rD0il9RIQ%3D%3D) the police movement, refusing to prosecute crimes, and letting criminals go free with a [slap on the wrist](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=db0bc5b065c14bf4838b813077990e1e&_e=gt2L2C9-BURbZLj1J-ToQEtMSUc9UuX3bBiKm2efhVUCPZlfE6cHNCJYZ_zboFULTQEqloKanZjT1xNkGpnu5G3mvP4F_PSw_9claE4BxA3Dg3Ec15D3lXwy-q1c2DnOx0XcpVpWH7_sr2KqoEq6jzlR2CdROrkTSfEoxLzB8mLR2KPRBVjSnXKX6giDZMhkYLC6CxKlI8MYjJ3UbcP9klc-9KPtEcH-I7g5xjmtn2y6fo47y1Cc8OpzhqmIA-3QD8hAvpyfNJer8bd1yMVCd1nkbpbrd3QmUn9X-QIQ06NaUQcEbhe8c-2LljkIdJf0PC1M4x6ZFS0BI4QNpRIDhQ%3D%3D), etc. Crime isn't an illness; it's a conscious choice. While mental illness sometimes plays a role, most criminals are responding to societal incentives—or the lack of incentives. It’s not complicated. When you reduce the punishment for crimes, when you reduce police departments and demoralize law enforcement, when you show people that they can get away with anarchy, when your policies say “crime DOES pay”—you get more of it. If liberal San Francisco can wake up and demand common sense, it’s time for the rest of America’s cities to get on board.

body:
This memo is long, but important.
Derek,
I know you don’t hear from me very often, but now that we’re a few weeks past John’s historic and commanding primary win, I wanted to share a memo with some of our top supporters (yes, that means you) about how we did.
It’s a bit long, but I think it’s really important that we show how we won this primary and what we need to do to win in November. **If you don’t have time to read through it all right now,[could you please make a donation right now to help us keep up with Dr. Oz’s self-funding campaign? With less than four months until the general election, we need youse guys to chip in whenever you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF)**
Alright, here ya go:
**TO:** Interested Parties
**FR:** Fetterman for PA
**RE:** How We Did It
* * *
John Fetterman racked up a huge margin of victory on primary night in practically every part of the state, winning all 67 counties and every demographic. As Senator Bob Casey observed, “I think it was a commanding performance by John Fetterman...I have never seen in a major race for the United State Senate, or governor, or even president, a more overwhelming primary win.” In a race with 4 candidates on the ballot, Fetterman received more than 50% of the vote in 65 of 67 counties. And in 33 counties, nearly half the counties in the state, his vote share was an incredible 70% or higher. [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF)_The New York Times, 5/23/22_ Despite the final margin of victory, Fetterman didn’t have an easy primary. While our campaign consistently outraised all of our opponents combined, an outside super PAC kept overall spending on television at parity, with $4,986,114 in total spending for Fetterman and $3,973,942 in spending for our closest opponent.**We were actually**** _outspent_****in the Philadelphia and Scranton-Wilkes Barre media markets.** But the Fetterman campaign spent our money wisely, stuck to our plan, and made every dollar spent on TV go farther than our opponents’. And because we relied on grassroots donations to the campaign and not massive checks to super PACs, we were able to take full advantage of the huge difference in advertising rates paid by campaigns versus outside groups, and our campaign was able to build a sustainable program that will scale for the general election. [**We were outspent in the primary and will likely be outspent in the general election, too. Please consider making a donation today to help us keep up with the corporate Super PACs and GOP million$ that will be spending on behalf of Dr. Oz.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) ******REDRAWING THE MAP FOR DEMOCRATS** We understood that to win Pennsylvania in a tough year like 2022, Democrats have to do things differently. We cannot afford to focus almost exclusively on Philadelphia and Pittsburgh while ignoring the rest of the state. Margins matter, even in counties that Democrats are never going to turn blue, and it’s become clear that Democrats need to be able to compete in rural counties as well as urban ones. Since John launched his campaign 16 months ago with the slogan ‘Every County, Every Vote,’ he has been clear that his campaign wouldn’t be writing off any part of the state. John has traveled across Pennsylvania, not only doing events but consistently drawing large, enthusiastic crowds in some of the Commonwealth’s reddest counties. As a result, John has built up strong support in the parts of the state where Democrats traditionally struggle. In fact,**John won 22 counties with more than 75% of the vote – and all but one of them voted for Trump in 2020.** [**If we’re going to flip this seat in November, we need to win votes in every county, not just those that are historically blue. Can you chip in today to help fund our outreach programs so John can continue flipping historically red counties?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) This has also given John a head start on the general election. While most nominees don’t start working to win over independent, moderate, and Republican voters until after the primary, that has been a focal point of John’s campaign since the very beginning. Even back in 2018, when John ran on the ticket with Governor Tom Wolf, he traveled all over the state, putting over 80,000 miles on his truck as he talked to voters in every corner — regardless of how red or blue. And with John as his running mate, Gov. Wolf won the general election by almost a million more votes than he did in 2014. John and Gov. Wolf also flipped six counties that had been won by Donald Trump in 2016. _“He has a chance to reach voters who wouldn’t_ _typically vote for a Democrat.”_ _The Atlantic, 5/17/22_ John Fetterman is exactly the kind of candidate that so many said we needed after Trump got elected: someone who can appeal to working class and rural voters who have been leaving the Democratic Party. But at the same time, he is the former four-term mayor of a town that is more than 70% Black, and has a long record of work in the community. John performed well in Philadelphia on primary night – especially when you consider that he was outspent on TV, it’s Kenyatta’s base (and “Philadelphia” appeared next to his name on the ballot), and Lamb had nearly every major endorsement in the city. In fact, as University of Pittsburgh Professor Lara Putnam pointed out, outside of Kenyatta’s base in Philadelphia, John performed well across a diversity of demographics, doing as well in precincts with large Black populations as he did in mostly white precincts: **[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF)** Primary results show that John Fetterman can and will compete in every part of Pennsylvania, including putting Republican counties, and Republican voters, in play. [**John has always been the Every Country, Every Vote candidate. By making a donation today, you will support our work to reach and turnout voters across PA.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) **THE PERFECT CANDIDATE FOR 2022** John has the right message, and is the right messenger, for a year like 2022. In a tough midterm election in which traditional Democrats are going to struggle, John doesn’t have to convince people he’s not like other Democrats or other politicians – they can see it for themselves. John is an authentic, straight-talking, no-BS populist whose style defies conventional labels. He just is who he is, and voters respect that. Throughout the primary, in fact, our opponents discovered just how hard it is to make labels stick. A leaked memo from an opposing super PAC admitted as much, noting that their main problem was that voters didn’t view John as too progressive for Pennsylvania. At a time when the Beltway media and insiders try to classify all Democrats as either part of the Bernie wing or the Biden wing, John defies categorization. As Vox wrote, John has “staked out a path between the political left and the center, and has developed a strong personal brand as a pragmatic outsider.” _“John Fetterman doesn’t just have supporters — he has fans.”_ _– The Philadelphia Inquirer, 4/20/22_ As the _Philadelphia Inquirer_ observed, “In a midterm election year when Democrats are expected to struggle, Fetterman's outsized frame and unconventional political demeanor has brought him something of a cult following.” That’s made John a rare phenomenon: a Democrat who nonetheless has a following that crosses partisan lines, and whose popularity isn’t necessarily tied to the popularity of the Democratic Party. John’s coalition is supporting him, no matter the Party’s approval rating. That grassroots enthusiasm helped power our victory, and it’s going to take that kind of enthusiasm to turn this seat blue in November. [**John not only doesn’t look like a traditional politician, but he doesn't act like one. That’s why he’s the candidate who can beat Dr. Oz in November. Can you make a donation today to support his campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) ******BUILDING A SMALL DOLLAR FUNDRAISING JUGGERNAUT** The strategic decisions that helped make this victory possible date back to the earliest days of the race. Starting with our first fundraising quarter, we invested the money we raised back into the campaign in order to ramp up our fundraising capacity. We built an aggressive digital fundraising operation and invested heavily in acquisition in order to build up a big donor base. We also went big on direct mail, a type of fundraising that some people might think is outdated. (It helps that John is the special kind of candidate who can get folks excited enough to write a check, find an envelope, and put it in a mailbox.) **Investing early and heavily in direct mail and in digital fundraising was a calculated gamble, but it’s really paid off. We not only dramatically outraised our opponents, we’ve also built a massive list of donors who can give again and again.**
* We’ve received over 600,000 contributions, from more than 200,000 unique donors.
* Donations have come from more than 88% of Pennsylvania zip codes with the most in-state donors of any candidate in this year’s Pennsylvania primaries, Democrat or Republican.
* The campaign’s average donation is $29, and more than 99% of Fetterman donors have not given the maximum contribution and can give again.
* In the first 24 hours following John’s primary win, and the campaign raised $1.6 million.

[**We wouldn’t be where we are today without the grassroots donations from supporters like you. We are a people-funded campaign through and through. By making a $5 donation today, you will help us carry our momentum to November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) **MOTIVATING AN UNMATCHED ORGANIZING OPERATION** Through a robust digital organizing program, the Fetterman campaign built an active and engaged group of grassroots volunteers who knocked doors, made calls, and sent texts to voters all across Pennsylvania. Powered by grassroots enthusiasm, the organizing operation contacted a staggering number of voters between launch and the day of the primary, and then managed to significantly scale it up during the get out the vote (GOTV) organizing period. Over the course of the campaign:
* The operation sent 4.2 million text messages, including 1.8 million during GOTV alone.
* Volunteers made nearly 120,000 phone calls to voters, more than half of which were made during GOTV.
* The volunteer-led organizing program registered more than 88,000 supporter IDs.

[**Organizing works. That’s why we are investing and growing our massive mobilization team to reach as many voters as possible. Can you chip in today to help fund it?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF) **WHAT IT MEANS FOR THE GENERAL ELECTION** There is no sugarcoating that this is going to be a tough political environment for Democrats. But John is a different kind of Democrat – someone who inspires genuine grassroots enthusiasm, connects with working class voters, and has proven that he can expand the map and win votes in both the bluest and the reddest counties in Pennsylvania. As the primary showed, John Fetterman is exactly the kind of candidate who can win in a tough year for Democrats. He’s a unique candidate with a strong personal brand that transcends partisanship, a massive grassroots fundraising operation, and the ability to appeal not only to core Democratic voters, but also to working class and rural voters in parts of the state where Democrats often struggle.
---
**[I hope this memo helped show you that John is the exact candidate we need to beat Dr. Oz and flip this seat in November. Can you make a donation today to fund our campaign? Every single dollar makes a difference for a people-powered campaign like ours.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220610-1?refcode=em20220610-6165&refcode2=6165_434096_8cX2lF&akid=6165%2E434096%2E8cX2lF)**

Thanks for reading.
More soon,
Joe

| | | Dear Peter, | **Washington, D.C.** – Representative Paul Gosar, DDS (AZ-04) issued the following statement after voting against H.R. 7910, the Unconstitutional Gun Restrictions Act, a radical and blatantly unconstitutional gun control bill. “It didn’t take long for Joe Biden and House democrats to use the tragedies in Buffalo and Texas to push for more gun control measures. They blatantly disparage our God-given and Constitutionally protected right to self-defense. As crime rises to record levels across our country, thanks to democrat socialists who run our major cities, self-defense is more important than ever. In Washington, D.C., the democrats suggest with a straight face that if it wasn’t for a gun, these murderers would be well-adjusted individuals. Millions and millions of people are law abiding gun owners, knife owners and car owners. If a knife, car or gun is used in a crime, it is the person using those tools that should be prosecuted for their actions. Punishing law abiding gun owners is non-sensical and I won’t stand for it. The truth is, schools remain the most unprotected institutions in America, yet democrats hide from the fact that they pushed legislation to defund school police protection and fought to remove armed police from schools. I proposed a bill to harden school security. It cost a fraction of the $62 billion we just sent to Ukraine. Our children should be our priority, not Ukrainians. Our leaders in Washington swore oaths to defend and uphold the rights enumerated in the Constitution. And the Second Amendment places clear limitations on government power to restrict lawful gun ownership. Today’s vote on these sweeping, authoritarian gun control laws are a betrayal to the Constitution and an assault on the rights and liberties of law-abiding gun owners and that is why I voted against it. Congress should be focusing on school safety and mental health, not gun control,” **concluded Congressman Gosar.**

body:
Rick Caruso is in big trouble in the runoff this November.

TO: Interested Parties
FROM: Doug Herman, General Consultant
RE: State of the Race - The November Runoff
* * *

We all saw what happened this election. Rick Caruso tried to knock Karen Bass out of the runoff and he failed.

This race now stands with Karen Bass at 38.8% and Rick Caruso at 40.5%.

A billionaire luxury real-estate developer spent $40 million selling himself as the 30 second sound bite savior of Los Angeles. Caruso assumed that his wealth, low voter turnout, and an onslaught of attack ads would propel him into an outright primary win.

He did everything in his power to avoid a head-to-head November election against Congresswoman Bass. Because Rick Caruso’s best – only – shot at winning this election was to sneak his way to 50 percent in the primary.

Rick Caruso is in big trouble in the runoff this November.

**Massive Spending Advantage**
Rick Caruso’s spending accounted for 75 percent of all money in the race. That doesn’t include the special interest police union PAC dollars that funded racist, dog-whistle attack ads against the Congresswoman. This level of spending is completely unprecedented in a municipal race – our campaign was outspent 14:1 – and it still wasn’t enough to knock the Congresswoman out.

**Historically Low Voter Turnout**
Our campaign was up against the lowest statewide primary turnout in over 100 years – giving Caruso’s Republican-aligned base an edge. Our grassroots base of support is in communities that traditionally turn out in stronger numbers during general elections: young people, communities of color, and working-class voters. During the coming months, our campaign will ramp up our on-the-ground organizing efforts, knocking on doors in neighborhoods that are historically overlooked in local elections – meeting voters where they are and in the language that they speak.

**Democratic and Republican Lanes**
There were two lanes in this race: one for Democrats, and one for Republicans. While the Republican lane consolidated behind Caruso, the Bass campaign was competing with other progressive Democrats. The Democratic lane for voters was vibrant and led by Karen Bass, totaling votes beyond 57% for the Democratic lane candidates. In Tuesday’s election, the Democratic lane outpolled the Republican lane by 49,418 votes. November is a race between a Democrat and a Republican, and in Los Angeles, the Democrat will win.

**Bass’ Popular Progressive Record**
Poll after poll shows us that voters in Los Angeles want a progressive leader – someone who can deliver meaningful, material change to their lives. Bass has a distinctive advantage over Caruso in this regard. She can point to both long-standing support for and activism around progressive policies, and the results that show she has delivered victories for Los Angeles at every level of government – from making major investments in communities of color as an organizer, to rescuing the state from economic collapse as a leader in the State Assembly, to working relentlessly for foster children and good-paying jobs in Congress.

**United Democratic Support Favors Bass**
Rick Caruso’s only path to victory was through a large and fragmented Democratic field of candidates. Now, Democrats will unite behind Karen Bass’ forward-looking, hopeful vision for the future of Los Angeles.

Karen Bass will be boosted by a broad, unified base of support from the progressive base of the Democratic party, the labor movement, and people from every part of the city joining together to make Los Angeles, a safer, more affordable place to live.

Despite being outspent 14-1, multiple Democrats splitting the Democratic vote and one of the lowest ever primary turnout elections, Karen Bass still stands as the frontrunner in the race to become Los Angeles mayor.

Let’s do this together, on to victory in November!

The latest news from the Republican Party of Wisconsin

| | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=1)

### June 10, 2022
Friend -- We hope you are having a great June! Wisconsin Republicans have been full steam ahead since our State Convention in May, and we are looking forward to more events across the state as we bring our message to every corner of Wisconsin. This weekend, our grassroots activists across the state will be having a Weekend of Action and talking to critical voters. Sign up **[here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zuf7fWO9bJnQbitbD556p8puzIZX7pa427BiAUtTwN9llM2c3AN0g81GgLowntHHe5347CXhuiK2Za3lRfCflw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=2)** to get involved this weekend to support Senator Johnson in this crucial election.
As we continue to ramp up our efforts ahead of November, we are looking for conservatives who are ready to join the fight. If you haven’t already, you can sign up to volunteer [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=3). As always, thanks for all you do! \- Team WisGOP | The Republican Party of Wisconsin is excited to celebrate National Dairy Month! Wisconsin is home to nearly 1.3 million dairy cows who produce 88 million pounds of milk each day. Republicans are proud to celebrate the farmers who feed our state and greatly contribute to our economy.
Last week, the Milwaukee Common Council [**voted**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=0nAsjXlSQBMBQwwSMnb0zFzBOQ6aT54VuZgX030Ld6Z33rK_M9AizhSkmDTy5SO8O488Z-Zi7hxYfwo-IRtjC886pgILR1yMIb7fvix5akrRpvZw0n0eroYkNUIfCT15&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=4) unanimously to approve a framework for Milwaukee to host the 2024 Republican National Convention. As Chairman Paul Farrow said in our [**press release**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R72aAQRdpUWAFwuxNARiAVuHZuIiBvwJUffJWrqE3Y_su2E2f8KWG-ordZLVFzsIASJjdOim5w3ob1II8pr3Yxj4AkV0mHVo62vv9YdVrtZMSBSgUEq8jJg5JAdUqjpvw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=5) , this unanimous vote was yet another testament to the broad support our bid has received from elected officials across the political spectrum, the business community, and the public. A 2024 Milwaukee convention would bring hundreds of millions of dollars to Wisconsin and would allow us to speak directly to America’s Heartland. No matter the outcome, we are inspired by how the Milwaukee community has come together in support of this effort.” We look forward to hearing the RNC’s final selection this summer!

| | Senator Ron Johnson submitted over 30,000 nomination signatures to get on the November ballot – breaking the state record previously set at 13,000 and doubling the number of signatures of all major Democrat candidates combined! Despite millions in Democrat spending, Senator Johnson is breaking records because of the unprecedented energy behind him. The momentum is on the side of Senator Johnson and Republicans, and this historic accomplishment was just the start.
As veterans endure horrific abuse at the Veterans Home at Union Grove, Tony Evers’ administration is shifting blame, despite previously refusing resources to address the facility’s abysmal quality of care. According to reports by the [**Milwaukee Journal Sentinel**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2ApbjIiPJvvoXlW8L6X3eRCG8FQqq35r_J_6vEhW_e4qz6lsNCpaOcEVnZsZw4hwXbfOTFKvWPy2Z9UBTojlyxw74yv8LcoRPpEF3NmzR8nvpqcsMchloEQT7yUDI4fohB6s_lWbDbmhvabeC_i3pKepMUmXbf2oL1BwRFsyPed6Ns_SWBZdrVx92BAV_dcQc76OwANi1ModOAkixkcuJ6g&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=6) and [**Wisconsin Spotlight**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=FZeaJrGkqb-JdJpt5MxOBLJsdDKp7AeIiu8R8SikDviyTBShzw9X9zkKtPyBOXdOE3HlrVxKW7VIFvqJieqUQmprioWCZlifcONYolaO2k0&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=7) , veterans at the Union Grove home are suffering from “cruel treatment” while state officials are failing to take complaints seriously. Our brave men and women who have served our country deserve better than to be told to “suck it up,” but it’s par for the course under Tony Evers’ mismanaged state government.

### **In Case You Missed It...**
### _[**FACT CHECK: Democrats Shift Blame for Soft-on-Crime Failures**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0bk7uVMSajLGrRvVBEW4A4BlRb-UtzeCH3yUQmZrGEkJDCSpdu9wWgbCyQosk8nOyMp0mRSnqQZwSh3EtPw_ivk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=10)_
Democrats know that rising crime will be a major campaign issue in 2022 – yet instead of owning up to their failures, they’re trying to blame Republicans. In another negative ad from the left, the liberal PAC Majority Forward took an empty swing at Senator Johnson’s voting record on crime, but neglected to mention Democrats’ history of emboldening far-left movements like “defund the police” while failing to hold bad actors accountable.
### _[**What They’re Saying: Inflation Pummels Wisconsinites at the Pump**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0UUT5kNHhproYMsZ99i1s_pL3hvGjcBdq2cuzis8v2VSbSV-h7WlxUIy_2BDvoY5OCPoAwIKMibUMNmZv3v-jWlUsk5m1OZdi-zK1RK8VRjM&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_6_10_22_v1&n=11)_
Across Wisconsin, families are hurting from Democrat-fueled inflation at the pump. As the state average hits $4.80 a gallon, prices in communities like Milwaukee and Kenosha have already topped $5 per gallon following a year of massive spending and anti-energy policies under Joe Biden. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I grew up working poor in a disregarded and discounted place, and I
understand just how important the right to be seen and heard can be.

That’s why I’m traveling to every corner of our state — I want all
Georgians to know that I am fighting for them and with them.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1455?refcode=sa_em_220610_B1_AllGeorgians_S1_T1_SYA_t4&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1001&akid=599%2E1862389%2EnWkcYX ]But I cannot be everywhere at once. Can you make your
first contribution
today to help me and our campaign reach voters all across Georgia? Your
$5 contribution makes a real difference as we work to
overcome Brian Kemp’s multi-million-dollar fundraising advantage.

As I travel across the state, from Cuthbert to Savannah to Athens, I lead
with one question: “How can I help?”

While the specific answers vary, a common theme remains. Georgians tell me
they want the chance to not just survive but to thrive — but right now,
under this governor, there are too many barriers in their way.

Brian Kemp doesn’t care about the Georgians he’s leaving behind. He’s out
for himself, making decisions based on politics, not people.

Right now, Kemp has a multi-million-dollar fundraising advantage over us.
I need the most robust grassroots team in Georgia history by my side so
that we can push back against his dirty tricks and reach every voter
possible.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1455?refcode=sa_em_220610_B1_AllGeorgians_S1_T1_SYA_t4&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=599%2E1862389%2EnWkcYX ]If you’re committed to helping me open the gates of opportunity for all

Stacey Abrams
